blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Global canopy height maps are increasingly used to estimate forest carbon, yet their regional accuracy is rarely tested. We present wall-to-wall maps of canopy height (10~m) and aboveground carbon density (30~m) for the Brazilian Atlantic Forest in 2024. Height was predicted by a deep learning network fusing Sentinel-2 reflectance, Sentinel-1 and ALOS PALSAR backscatter and ALOS elevation, trained on 7{,}179 and tested on 1{,}793 patches (58{,}800~km$^2$) from a statewide airborne LiDAR campaign over São Paulo state, Brazil. On held-out test patches, the root mean square error is 3.05~m at 10~m and 2.58~m at 30~m, and the model was validated at two LiDAR sites outside São Paulo. Over the same pixels, the Meta and World Resources Institute global product has more than twice this error. A power law fitted to 124 inventory plots converted canopy height to above ground carbon density. The remaining forest holds 1{,}944~Tg~C over 28.3~Mha. Global products therefore need local validation before use in carbon accounting.
blocks.zh: 全球林冠高地图被越来越多地用于估计森林碳,但其区域准确性却很少被测试. 我们为2024年的巴西大西洋森林绘制了树冠高度(10~m)和地上碳密度(30~m)的从墙到墙的地图。 高度是由一个深层学习网络预言的: 引信Sentinel-2反射、Sentinel-1和ALOS PALSAR后向散射和ALOS高地,经过7{,}179次训练,并经过1{,}793个补丁(58{,}800~km$^2$)测试,来自巴西圣保罗州上空的全州空中LiDAR运动. 在被搁置的测试补丁上,根平均平方误差为:10~m时为3.05~m;30~m时为2.58~m;该模型在圣保罗外的两个LiDAR站点被验证. 在同一像素上,Meta和世界资源研究所的全球产品有超过两倍的这个错误. 配有124个库存地块的动力定律将树冠高度转换为地上碳密度。 其余的森林占据着 1{,}944~Tg~C大于28.3~Mha. 因此,全球产品在用于碳核算之前需要当地验证。

blocks.en: Background & Summary
blocks.zh: 背景摘要( T)

blocks.en: Global and regional canopy height maps derived from satellite imagery have recently been released at resolutions from 30 m down to 1 m 27 , 18 , 43 , 23 , 46 . Canopy height maps are increasingly converted into biomass and carbon, either from a global product 4 or from maps produced for a specific region 37 , 22 , 47 . Errors in canopy height are therefore carried into the carbon estimates. Yet the accuracy of the global products is rarely known at the regional scale. These products are built to perform everywhere, and independent measurements of canopy height over areas large and varied enough to test them within a region are scarce. Airborne light detection and ranging (LiDAR) surveys that cover entire states or countries can fill this gap. The canopy height model derived from such a survey spans the full range of forest types, relief and land use of a region, and can be used both to evaluate a global product and to train a regional model.
blocks.zh: 根据卫星图像绘制的全球和区域冠状高度图最近在分辨率从30米降到1米27、18、43、23、46。 冠状高地图越来越多地转化为生物量和碳,要么来自全球产品4,要么来自为特定区域制作的地图37、22、47。 因此,树冠高度的误差计入碳估算。 然而,全球产品的准确性在区域范围内鲜为人知。 这些产品是用来在各地进行操作的,对大面积和多样性足以在一个区域内检验的树冠高度的独立测量也很少。 覆盖整个州或国家的空载光探测和测距(LiDAR)调查可以填补这一空白. 这种调查得出的树冠高度模型涵盖一个区域的全部森林类型、救济和土地利用,既可用于评估全球产品,也可用于培训区域模型。

blocks.en: The interest in canopy height stems from its link to biomass. Biomass information is obtained from forest inventories, which measure trees in plots of up to 1 ha. Although this is the most accurate method, it covers only small areas and is costly. Remote sensing is the only means of extending plot measurements to entire landscapes, provided that the sensor captures a forest attribute closely related to biomass. Among the forest attributes that can be retrieved from remote sensing, canopy height is the one most closely related to aboveground biomass. At plot scale, top canopy height alone explains most of the variance in biomass density 1 . Canopy height is also the attribute that remote sensing measures most accurately, through LiDAR. A LiDAR sensor emits laser pulses and times their return. Part of each pulse is reflected by the canopy top and part by the ground, through gaps in the foliage, and the difference between the two returns gives canopy height 12 . Acquiring airborne LiDAR over hundreds of thousands of hectares, however, is expensive, and spaceborne LiDAR samples the surface only in discrete footprints 12 . Large-scale estimates therefore rely on optical and radar imagery, which cover the entire surface at regular intervals. These sensors do not measure height directly. Their signals respond to canopy structure only indirectly and saturate at moderate biomass. They can, however, be calibrated against LiDAR where both are available, and the calibrated model can then be applied wherever imagery exists. This is how most large-scale carbon maps have been produced 35 , 3 , 2 . Predicting canopy height from imagery calibrated with LiDAR is therefore the most direct route to a wall-to-wall carbon map.
blocks.zh: 对树冠高度的兴趣源于其与生物量的联系. 生物量信息来自森林清单,该清单测量1公顷以下的地块中的树木。 虽然这是最准确的方法,但只覆盖小面积,费用高昂. 遥感是将地块测量扩展到整个景观的唯一手段,条件是传感器能够捕捉与生物量密切相关的森林属性。 在可从遥感中检索到的森林属性中,树冠高度是与地面生物量最密切相关的。 在地块尺度上,仅顶棚高度就解释了生物量密度1的大部分差异。 冠高也是遥感测量最准确的属性,通过LiDAR. 一个LiDAR传感器发出激光脉冲,并且是它们的返回时间. 每个脉搏的部分由树冠顶部和部分由地面反应,通过叶片间隙,两个回落的区别使树冠高度达到12. 然而,在数十万公顷的土地上获得空中LiDAR是昂贵的,而太空LiDAR只用离散的足迹对表面进行取样。 12. 因此,大规模估计依赖于定期覆盖整个表面的光学和雷达图像。 这些传感器不直接测量高度。 它们的信号只在中度生物量下对树冠结构作出间接反应和饱和反应. 然而,在两者都有可用的情况下,可以对照LiDAR进行校准,然后在存在图像的地方可以应用校准模型. 这就是最大规模碳图的制作方式 35、3、2。 因此,从与LiDAR校准的图像中预测树冠高度是通往墙对墙碳图的最直接路线。

blocks.en: The Brazilian Atlantic Forest is one of the regions where accurate canopy height and carbon maps are most needed. It has been reduced to roughly a quarter of its original extent, and what remains is dispersed over tens of thousands of small remnants and regenerating forest patches embedded in a matrix of pasture, cropland and tree plantation 30 , 29 . It is also the region where the largest restoration commitments in the tropics are being implemented 7 , 41 , and where fragments hold a quarter to a third less biomass than less disturbed reference stands 20 , human disturbance outweighs climate as a driver of carbon stocks 28 , and several million hectares have regrown since 1985 39 , 33 . Quantifying these processes, and identifying where restoration would yield the largest carbon gains, requires biomass and carbon maps fine enough to resolve individual fragments.
blocks.zh: 巴西大西洋森林是最需要准确的林冠高度和碳图的区域之一. 它已减少到最初的四分之一左右,残存的残骸已散布在数万块小残块和植入草场、耕地和树木种植园的林地中。 也是热带地区最大的恢复承诺正在得到落实的区域,7,41, 碎片的生物量比不太扰动的参考量少四分之一到三分之一, 人类的扰动超过气候作为碳储量的驱动力 28, 数百万公顷自1985年39,33以来已重新生长。 量化这些过程并确定何处恢复将产生最大的碳收益,需要生物质和碳图精细,足以解决单个碎片。

blocks.en: Where dense airborne LiDAR is available for training, deep learning models reach errors of a few metres, as shown by the country-wide maps of Switzerland from Sentinel-2 19 and of France from Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2 and GEDI 37 . The Atlantic Forest lacked the training data for an equivalent effort until 2023 and 2024, when an airborne LiDAR campaign was flown over the State of São Paulo, in south-eastern Brazil. The state covers about 248,000 km 2 , an area comparable to that of the United Kingdom, and lies mostly within the Atlantic Forest region. It contains every forest formation of the region, from the dense evergreen forest of the Serra do Mar, the coastal mountain range, to the seasonal semi-deciduous forest of the interior plateau and the mixed Araucaria forest of the highlands, across the full range of relief and fragmentation the region presents. We used the canopy height model derived from this campaign to train a deep learning model that predicts canopy height from satellite imagery, applied this model to map canopy height and, from it, aboveground carbon across the entire Atlantic Forest, and used the same LiDAR reference to evaluate a global canopy height product.
blocks.zh: 在有密集的空中LiDAR可供训练的地方,深层学习模型会达到几米的误差,如瑞士从哨兵-2 19到法国从哨兵-1、哨兵-2和GEDI 37的全国地图所示。 大西洋森林缺乏同等努力的培训数据,直到2023年和2024年在巴西东南部圣保罗州上空进行了空中LiDAR运动。 该州占地约24.8万平方公里,面积与英国相当,大部分位于大西洋森林地区. 它包含该区域每一个森林的形成,从沿海山脉Serra do Mar的密集的常绿森林,到内陆高原的季节性半荒漠森林和高原混合的Araucaria森林,这些森林分布于该区域带来的各种救济和分裂。 我们利用从这次运动中衍生出来的树冠高度模型来训练一个从卫星图像中预测树冠高度的深层学习模型,将这个模型应用于绘制树冠高度图,并从中绘制横跨整个大西洋森林的地表碳,并使用同样的LiDAR参考来评价一个全球树冠高度产品.

blocks.en: The dataset has two main layers. The first is a canopy height model of the entire Brazilian Atlantic Forest for 2024 at 10 m resolution, predicted by a deep learning model that combines Sentinel-2 optical imagery, Sentinel-1 and ALOS PALSAR radar imagery, and the ALOS elevation data. The second is an aboveground carbon density map at 30 m resolution, derived from the predicted canopy height through a relationship fitted to 124 forest inventory plots with LiDAR-derived canopy height. The two layers are accompanied by the standard error of the carbon density at 30 m, by a summary of the mean carbon density and its uncertainty at 1 km, and by versions of both maps without the forest mask (“Data Records”).
blocks.zh: 数据集主要分两层. 第一个是2024年整个巴西大西洋森林10米分辨率的树冠高度模型,由Sentinel-2光学图像、Sentinel-1和ALOS PALSAR雷达图像以及ALOS高地数据相结合的深层学习模型预测。 第二幅是30米分辨率的地面碳密度图,通过与124块林木清单地块和LiDAR衍生林冠高度的关系,从预测的林冠高度中推导出来。 这两层还伴有30米碳密度的标准误差,1公里的平均碳密度及其不确定性的汇总,以及没有森林遮盖的两种地图版本(“数据记录”)。

blocks.en: On held-out test patches in São Paulo, the predicted canopy height has a root mean square error of 3.05 m at 10 m resolution and 2.58 m at 30 m. At two sites outside São Paulo the error remains below 5 m, in southern Bahia at a site that lies outside every training patch and in Santa Catarina at a site covered by the patches used to fine-tune the model. Over the same test areas in São Paulo, the global canopy height product of Meta and the World Resources Institute 23 , 43 has more than twice this error and underestimates canopy height by about a third. This contrast indicates that global canopy height products need regional validation against airborne LiDAR before they are used to estimate biomass and carbon. Canopy height explains 76% of the variance in plot carbon density.
blocks.zh: 在圣保罗的搁置测试补丁上,预测的树冠高度有一个根平均方形错误,10米分辨率为3.05米,30米分辨率为2.58米. 在圣保罗以外的两个地点,误差仍然在5米以下,在巴伊亚南部,一个地点位于每个培训补丁之外,在圣卡塔琳娜,一个地点则位于用来微调模型的补丁所覆盖。 在圣保罗的同一个试验区,Meta和世界资源研究所23的全球冠高产品,43有两倍以上的误差,低估了冠高约三分之一。 这一对比表明,全球树冠高度产品在用于估计生物量和碳之前,需要针对空中LiDAR进行区域验证。 Canopy高度解释了地块碳密度差异的76%.

blocks.en: Summed over the ten natural domains of the Atlantic Forest defined by the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE) 16 , which contain 98.9% of the mapped forest, the remaining forest covers 28.3 Mha and holds 1,944 Tg C at a mean density of 68.8 Mg C ha -1 . The model was never given this regionalization. Even so, median carbon density across its domains spans almost a factor of five, from 21 Mg C ha -1 on the north-eastern coast to 99 Mg C ha -1 in the dense forest of the eastern south-east, following the gradient of forest cover predicted by the region’s fragmentation history. The dataset provides a regionally calibrated baseline for carbon accounting, for tracking regrowth and degradation at the fragment scale, and for prioritizing restoration where commitments are largest.
blocks.zh: 巴西地理和统计研究所(IBGE)16 界定的大西洋森林的10个自然领域包含98.9%的地图林,其余的森林覆盖28.3 Mha,拥有1 944 Tg C,平均密度为68.8 Mg C ha-1。 这一模式从未被赋予这种区域化。 纵然如此,整个地区的碳密度中位数几乎为五倍,从东北沿海的21兆克(Ha-1)到东南东部密集森林的99兆克(Ha-1),这与该区域破碎历史预测的森林覆盖梯度相同。 数据集为碳核算、跟踪碎块规模的再生长和退化、以及在承诺最大的地方优先恢复提供了区域校准基线。

blocks.en: Methods
blocks.zh: 方法

blocks.en: The dataset was produced in five stages. A statewide airborne LiDAR campaign over the State of São Paulo was processed into 10 m canopy height models and paired with annual composites of Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1, ALOS PALSAR and the ALOS digital surface model on a grid of 2.56 km patches. A four-branch fusion network was trained on these patches, fine-tuned with 252 patches from other airborne LiDAR surveys and evaluated on held-out patches of the same grid. The trained network was applied to the entire Atlantic Forest region for the year 2024. The predicted height was aggregated to 30 m and converted into aboveground carbon density with a power law calibrated on 124 inventory plots with co-located LiDAR. Finally, the product was evaluated against two airborne LiDAR surveys outside São Paulo, compared with a global canopy height product over the same pixels and summarized by natural domain. The following subsections describe each stage.
blocks.zh: 数据集分五个阶段制作. 圣保罗州上空的全州范围空中LiDAR运动被加工成10米的树冠高度模型,并配有每年的Sentinel-2、Sentinel-1、ALOS PALSAR和ALOS数字表面模型,网格为2.56公里的补丁。 一个四分支聚变网络接受了关于这些补丁的培训,并用其他空中LiDAR调查中的252个补丁进行了微调,并对同一网格的搁置补丁进行了评价。 训练有素的网络在2024年被应用于整个大西洋森林地区. 预测的高度被集合到30米,并转化为地面碳密度,在124个库存地块上对电源定律进行了校准,合用LiDAR。 最后,该产品根据圣保罗市外的两次空中LiDAR调查进行了评价,相比之下,在同一像素上有一个全球冠高产品,并按自然域进行了总结。 以下各小节介绍每个阶段。

blocks.en: Study area
blocks.zh: 研究领域

blocks.en: The study area is the Atlantic Forest region of Brazil (Fig. 1 ). The Atlantic Forest originally covered some 112 Mha along a wide latitudinal gradient of the Brazilian coast, reaching inland across 15 of the 27 Brazilian states 29 , from the tropical north-east to the subtropical south, and from sea level to more than 2,000 m in the Serra do Mar and Serra da Mantiqueira ranges. Five centuries of land conversion have reduced it to a fraction of that extent — estimates range from 11.7–16% of forest cover 30 to 28% of native vegetation when non-forest formations and young regrowth are included 29 — distributed as tens of thousands of small, isolated and strongly edge-affected fragments. Despite this, the region remains a biodiversity hotspot, with high levels of endemism 25 , and it is the focus of some of the largest forest restoration commitments in the tropics.
blocks.zh: 该研究区为巴西大西洋森林区(图1). 大西洋森林最初覆盖了巴西海岸宽纬度梯度线上的约112 Mha,从热带东北到亚热带南部的27个巴西州中的15个达到内陆,从海平面到Serra do Mar和Serra da Mantiqueira的2 000多米。 5个世纪的土地转换将土地转换减少到这一程度的一小部分——估计森林覆盖率从11.7%到16%不等,在将非森林形成和年轻再生长包括29个时,当地植被的30%到28%不等——分布在数以万计的小型、孤立和受到强烈边缘影响的碎片上。 尽管如此,该区域仍然是生物多样性热点,当地特有性25强,是热带地区一些最大的森林恢复承诺的重点。

blocks.en: The State of São Paulo as reference window
blocks.zh: 圣保罗州作为参考窗口

blocks.en: The airborne LiDAR reference data used to train and evaluate the models (“LiDAR reference data”) come from a statewide campaign over São Paulo (Fig. 1 ), complemented in the fine-tuning of the final model by 252 patches from other surveys (“Experimental design”). The São Paulo state contains a variety of forest formations recognized in the Atlantic Forest region, together with the ecological gradients that generate them. Dense ombrophilous forest occupies the coastal escarpment of the Serra do Mar. Mixed ombrophilous ( Araucaria ) forest occurs in the higher, colder portions of the Mantiqueira and Bocaina highlands; seasonal semi-deciduous forest dominates the interior plateau; and the associated ecosystems of the region, such as mangrove, restinga , and high-altitude grassland, are all present along the coastal plain and on the summits. The state also spans the contact zone between the Atlantic Forest and the Cerrado, a distinct savanna-dominated domain that officially occupies part of the interior of the state. The forest sampled by the calibration patches inside the official limits of the Cerrado is essentially seasonal semi-deciduous forest, the same physiognomy that dominates the interior of the Atlantic Forest, so these patches were kept in the calibration set, whereas the savanna formations are excluded by the forest mask (“MapBiomas forest mask”).
blocks.zh: 用于培训和评价模型的空中LiDAR参考数据(“LiDAR参考数据”)来自圣保罗上空的全州运动(图1),其他调查(“实验设计”)的252个补丁对最后模型进行了微调。 圣保罗州包含大西洋森林地区公认的各种森林形态,以及产生它们的生态梯度. 红树林、休斯加和高海拔草原等区域相关生态系统都分布在沿海平原和山峰上。 该州还横跨大西洋森林和塞拉多之间的接触区,这是一片明显的以草原为主的领地,正式占据该州部分内地. Cerrado官方界限内的校准补丁所采样的森林基本上是季节性的半阴性森林,是主宰大西洋森林内部的同样的生理学特征,因此这些补丁被保存在校准套中,而草原形态则被森林面具("Map Biomas Forest mask")排除在外.

blocks.en: Along the coastal region, the Atlantic Forest predominates, especially ombrophilous formations characterized by annual rainfall exceeding 2,000 mm and a mean annual temperature of approximately 22 ∘ C. These forests, extending across the Serra do Mar mountain range, sustain high levels of endemism and biodiversity 25 . The abundant year-round rainfall, without a marked dry season, supports a dense evergreen canopy and the tallest stands in the study area. Inland, the vegetation transitions into seasonal semi-deciduous forests in the central portion of the state, where annual precipitation ranges between 1,000 and 1,500 mm and the mean annual temperature is about 20 ∘ C. In these forests, a well-defined dry season induces significant leaf shedding 44 . Savanna-like formations of the Cerrado are also present, dominated by a mixture of scattered trees, shrubs and extensive grasslands, occurring where annual rainfall varies from 800 to 1,600 mm and mean annual temperature is around 24 ∘ C.
blocks.zh: 沿沿海地区,大西洋森林占主导地位,特别是以年降雨量超过2000毫米和年平均气温约22°C为特征的乌布罗菲卢斯层。 这些森林横跨Serra do Mar山脉,保持了高度的特有性和生物多样性。 全年雨量充沛,没有明显的旱季,支撑着密集的常绿树冠和研究区最高的立面. 内陆,植被在州中心地区向季节性半阴性森林过渡,其中年降水量在1000至1500毫米之间,年平均气温约为20°C. 在这些森林中,一个明确定义的旱季会导致大量叶片的枯萎44。 塞拉多河的类似萨凡纳的形成也存在,以散落的树木,灌木和大片草地的混合为主,其年降雨量从800毫米到1600毫米不等,年平均气温在24°C左右.

blocks.en: This ecological gradient is important to the present study. The seasonal semi-deciduous and savanna formations of the interior undergo a pronounced phenological change between the rainy and the dry season, whereas the coastal ombrophilous forests remain evergreen, so that no single seasonal composite is equally informative everywhere. An annual composite of satellite imagery, which integrates the full phenological cycle, is the acquisition window that behaves consistently across the whole gradient, and it is the one adopted here (“Satellite imagery”). Radar backscatter, which responds to canopy geometry and water content rather than to leaf pigments, is comparatively more stable across seasons and penetrates canopies where optical reflectance saturates, while terrain elevation carries the topographic prior that separates the tall, humid escarpment forests from the shorter, more disturbed plateau remnants. This complementarity is what motivates the multi-sensor design described below.
blocks.zh: 这种生态梯度对本研究很重要. 内陆的季节性半衰期和热带草原形成在雨季和旱季之间发生了明显的现象变化,而沿海的乌姆布罗菲卢斯森林则保持常绿化,因此,没有单一的季节性复合材料在任何地方都具有同等的信息。 卫星图象的年度综合体将整个现象学周期融为一体,是整个梯度中始终一致的获取窗口,也是此处采用的窗口(“卫星图象”)。 雷达反散射对树冠几何和含水量的反应,而不是对叶色素的反应,在不同季节比较稳定,并穿透了光学反射饱和层的树冠,而地形高地的地形将高高的湿润树叶林与更短、更扰动的高原残迹区分开来。 这种互补性是下文所述多传感器设计的动力。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Study area. The Atlantic Forest region is outlined in the inset; the main panel shows the State of São Paulo, the reference window from which the training and test patches of the calibration grid were drawn and which contains a variety of forest formations. Cyan and magenta polygons indicate, respectively, the training and testing patches of size 2.56 × \times 2.56 km. Red dots mark the 124 field plots used to convert canopy height into aboveground carbon density.
blocks.zh: 图1:研究领域。 大西洋森林区域在插图中概述;主板显示圣保罗州,这是校准网格的培训和测试补丁的参考窗口,包含各种森林编组. 青色和紫红色多边形分别表示大小2.56×\times 2.56 km的训练和测试补丁. 红点标记了用来将树冠高度转化为地面碳密度的124个野外地块.

blocks.en: LiDAR reference data
blocks.zh: LiDAR 参考数据

blocks.en: We used airborne LiDAR data acquired in a statewide campaign covering the entire territory of São Paulo during 2023 and 2024, coordinated by the Instituto Geográfico e Cartográfico do Estado de São Paulo (IGC-SP) and conducted with multiple LiDAR sensors with an average density of about 10 points per square metre.
blocks.zh: 我们在圣保罗地理研究所(IGC-SP)的协调下,利用在2023年和2024年覆盖圣保罗全州范围内的全州范围内获得的LiDAR数据,使用平均密度约为每平方米10点的多个LiDAR传感器进行。

blocks.en: CHM generation was performed with an automated workflow implemented in R with the lidR package 34 . First, ground returns were identified with the Cloth Simulation Filter (CSF) 48 ( classify_ground with csf ). CSF inverts the point cloud and simulates a rigid cloth falling onto it under gravity. The equilibrium position of the cloth approximates the terrain surface from below, and every return within a distance threshold of that surface is classified as ground. We used the package defaults (cloth resolution of 0.5 m, classification threshold of 0.5 m, 500 iterations, a time step of 0.65 and a rigidness of 1) without the slope post-processing option. CSF requires no window-size or slope parameterization, so a single parameter set behaves acceptably over terrain ranging from the flat interior plateau to the escarpments of the Serra do Mar.
blocks.zh: CHM 生成是用一个自动工作流程进行,在R中与 lidR 软件包 34 一起执行. 首先,地面返回用Cloth模拟滤镜(CSF)48(用csf_ground_)确定. CSF颠倒了点云,并模拟了在重力作用下坠落在它的硬布. 布料的平衡位置从下面接近地形表面,在该表面的距离阈值内的每一回返回都被归类为地面. 我们使用了包的默认值(服装分辨率为0.5米,分类阈值为0.5米,重复500次,时间步骤为0.65,刚性为1),没有坡度后处理选项. CSF不需要窗口大小或坡度参数化,因此单个参数集在平坦的内高原到塞拉杜马尔河的阶梯等地形上的行为是可以接受的.

blocks.en: Spurious returns were then flagged with the isolated-voxel filter ( classify_noise with ivf ). The algorithm voxelizes the point cloud and counts, for every point, the returns present in the 3 × 3 × 3 3\times 3\times 3 voxel neighbourhood centred on it. A point whose neighbourhood contains fewer than n n other returns is labelled as noise (ASPRS class 18) and discarded. We used a voxel side of 10 m and n = 12 n=12 , a permissive setting that removes only grossly isolated returns.
blocks.zh: 纯洁的返回随即被标注为隔离的-voxel过滤器(用ivf分类_噪声). 算法对点云进行voxel化,并计算每个点,以3×3×3×3×3×3×3×3×3×3×3×3×xxxxx3×3×xxxxxxx3×3×xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx3×3×xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxexxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 附近区域所含的返回量少于n的点被标记为噪音(ASPRS第18类)并被丢弃。 我们使用的是10米和n=12n=12的阴道侧面,这种允许设置只清除严重隔离的返回。

blocks.en: Point heights above ground were obtained by triangulation ( normalize_height with tin ). Ground returns are used as the vertices of a Delaunay triangulation, the terrain elevation is interpolated linearly inside each triangle at the planimetric position of every return, and this value is subtracted from the return elevation. Normalizing at the exact position of each point avoids the resampling error that an intermediate gridded DTM would introduce. Returns outside the convex hull of the ground points are extrapolated by inverse-distance weighting of their nearest ground neighbours.
blocks.zh: 地面上点高度是通过三角测量(与锡的正常高度)获得的. 地面返回被用作Delaunay三角形的顶点,地形高度在每一次返回的浮游位置线性地插入每个三角形内部,并将这一数值从返回高度中减去。 在每个点的确切位置实现正常化,可以避免中间网格DTM将引入的重样错误. 地面点的对流船体外的返回是通过对最近的地面邻居进行反距离加权来推断的。

blocks.en: CHMs were then produced at 1 m resolution with the point-to-raster algorithm ( rasterize_canopy with p2r ), which assigns to each cell the height of the highest return falling inside it, and exported as GeoTIFF. The 1 m CHMs were mosaicked per quadrant, aggregated to the 10 m Sentinel-2 grid by spatial averaging and reprojected to the coordinate reference system of the satellite mosaics (EPSG 4326, WGS 84), so that the reference height and the optical predictors share an identical pixel grid. This grid is regular in geographic coordinates, with a spacing of 8.983 × 10 − 5 8.983\times 10^{-5} degrees, the angle that corresponds to 10 m at the equator and the convention that Google Earth Engine applies to an export in EPSG 4326 at a scale of 10 m. The 25 and 30 m grids of the coarser predictors use 2.5 and 3 times this spacing. Pixel sizes in metres are therefore nominal throughout this paper. The size of a pixel along the meridian is within 1% of its nominal value, whereas its size along the parallel shrinks with the cosine of latitude, to about 9.2 m for a 10 m pixel at the latitude of São Paulo. In the 10 m CHM, a value of zero marks both bare ground and the absence of LiDAR data, which is why zero heights receive a separate treatment in training (“Training”) and are left out of the accuracy assessment (“Accuracy assessment”). The 10 m CHM is the regression target of all models reported here.
blocks.zh: 然后,CHMs用点对点算法(rasterize_canopy with p2r)在1m分辨率下生成,该算法为每个单元格分配掉在其中的最高返回高度,并作为GeoTIFF输出. 1 m CHMs按四象限进行镶嵌,按空间平均值归集到10 m Sentinel-2网格,并重新投射到卫星镶嵌图的坐标参照系统(EPSG 4326, WGS 84),这样参考高度和光学预测器共享一个相同的像素网格. 这个网格在地理坐标上是固定的,其间距为8.983×10−5 8.983\times 10^{-5}度,在赤道上对应于10米的角,以及Google Earth Earth Engine适用于EPSG 4326中以10米的尺度出口的公约. 25米和30米长的网格的剪切预测器使用这个间隔的2.5和3倍. 因此,本文中以米计的像素尺寸是名义上的。 沿经线的像素的大小在其面值的1%以内,而沿纬度的平行线的大小则与纬度的余弦收缩,在圣保罗纬度为10米的像素的长度约为9.2米. 在10 m CHM中,零的值标记了裸露的地面和没有LiDAR数据,这就是为什么零高度在训练中会得到单独的处理(“训练”),并且被排除在准确性评估(“准确性评估”)之外。 10 m CHM是本文中所有模型的回归目标.

blocks.en: Satellite imagery
blocks.zh: 卫星图像

blocks.en: All satellite predictors were assembled in Google Earth Engine (GEE) and exported over the same set of quadrants, so that every experiment shares an identical spatial footprint and differs only in the set of sensors used. We adopted the annual 2024 composite, built as a per-pixel median of all acquisitions between January and December 2024. However, whenever a specific sensor modality lacked coverage for this period, we gap-filled the dataset using the 2023 image acquired closest to the LiDAR flight date. We favoured the annual window approach for two main reasons. First, it is the only time frame that provides gap-free coverage across the entire study area for all sensors, as the ALOS PALSAR mosaic is produced yearly. Second, averaging the full phenological cycle ensures consistent data across the study area’s diverse gradient, from evergreen coastal forests to highly seasonal interior ones.
blocks.zh: 所有卫星预测器均组装在Google Earth引擎(GEE)中,并在同一组四角星上输出,因此每个实验都共享一个相同的空间足迹,仅在使用的传感器组中有所不同. 我们采用了每年2024年的复合材料,作为2024年1月至12月期间所有采购的每像素中位数。 然而,当一个特定的传感器模式在这一时期缺乏覆盖时,我们利用最接近LiDAR飞行日期的2023图像填补了数据集的空隙。 我们赞成年度窗口办法,原因有二。 首先,由于每年生产ALOS PALSAR马赛克,这是在整个研究区为所有传感器提供无缺口覆盖的唯一时限。 第二,平均整个酚系周期可确保整个研究地区从常绿沿海森林到高度季节性内陆森林的不同梯度数据的一致性。

blocks.en: Four products enter the network, each at its own native resolution, namely Sentinel-2 (optical, 10 m), Sentinel-1 (C-band SAR, 10 m), ALOS PALSAR (L-band SAR, 25 m), and ALOS DSM (elevation, 30 m). The images of each sensor are read, normalized, and encoded at its native pixel size, and the spatial alignment between modalities is performed inside the network, in feature space (“Multi-sensor fusion network”). This avoids the interpolation artefacts and the artificial sharpening that result from upsampling a coarse product to a 10 m grid before training.
blocks.zh: 4种产品进入网络,每个产品按其本土分辨率进行,分别是Sentinel-2(光学,10米),Sentinel-1(C-波段合成孔径雷达,10米),ALOS PALSAR(L-波段合成孔径雷达,25米)和ALOS DSM(线程,30米)。 每个传感器的图像按其原生像素大小进行读取、正常化和编码,在网络内部,在特征空间(“多传感器聚变网络”)中进行模式之间的空间对齐。 这样可以避免插图工艺品和人工磨削,在训练前将粗细的产品取样至10米网格。

blocks.en: Sentinel-2 (optical)
blocks.zh: 哨兵-2(光学)

blocks.en: We used Sentinel-2 MSI Level-2A bottom-of-atmosphere reflectance ( COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED ). Scenes with more than 50% cloud cover ( CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE ) were discarded, and the remaining scenes were masked per pixel with the scene-classification (SCL) band, removing cloud shadow, cloud medium probability, cloud high probability, and cirrus (SCL classes 3, 8, 9, and 10) before compositing. Ten spectral bands were retained. The four 10 m bands are B2 (blue, 459–525 nm), B3 (green, 542–578 nm), B4 (red, 649–680 nm) and B8 (NIR, 780–886 nm), and the six 20 m bands are B5 (697–712 nm), B6 (733–748 nm) and B7 (773–793 nm) (red edge), B8A (narrow NIR, 854–875 nm), and B11 (1568–1659 nm) and B12 (2115–2290 nm) (SWIR), the latter six resampled to 10 m with bilinear interpolation. The resulting ten-band stack at 10 m defines the reference grid . Reflectance values were kept as scaled integers and normalized at training time by a fixed divisor of 10,000, followed by clipping to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . No per-band min–max scaling was applied to the optical data, which keeps the normalization independent of the particular composite being used.
blocks.zh: 我们使用了哨兵-2 MSI级-2A层底层反射(COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED)。 云覆盖率超过50%的场景(CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE)被丢弃,其余场景则以场景分类(SCL)波段为每个像素遮掩,除去云阴影,云中概率,云中概率,云高概率,以及堆叠前的圆环(SCL类3,8,9和10). 保留了10个光谱带。 4个10米波段为B2(蓝色,459–525nm),B3(绿色,542–578nm),B4(红色,649–680nm)和B8(NIR,780–886nm),6个20米波段为B5(697–712nm),B6(733–748nm)和B7(773–793nm)(红色边缘),B8A(窄NRNH,854–875nm),以及B11(1568–1659nm)和B12(2115–2290nm)(SWIR),后6个波段以双线插图重印至10米. 生成的10米的十波段堆栈定义了参考网格. 反射值被保持为缩放整数,在训练时由1万个固定分光器正常化,然后剪切为[0,1] [0,1]. 光学数据没有采用每个波段的分程缩放法,光学数据使正常化独立于所使用的特定复合材料。

blocks.en: Sentinel-1 (C-band SAR)
blocks.zh: 哨兵-1(C波段搜索和救援)

blocks.en: Sentinel-1 GRD imagery ( COPERNICUS/S1_GRD ) in Interferometric Wide swath mode was used with dual polarization (VV and VH), processed with the standard GEE pipeline (thermal-noise removal, radiometric calibration to σ 0 \sigma^{0} and terrain correction with the SRTM DEM) and expressed in decibels. Per-pixel median composites were built for the same temporal windows and exported at the native 10 m pixel size, which coincides with the optical reference grid.
blocks.zh: 干涉测量中的哨兵-1GRD图像(COPERNICUS/S1_GRD) 使用宽斜度模式时采用双极化(VV和VH),用标准的GEE管道处理(去除热噪声,辐射校准为3/0\sigma^{0}和用SRTM DEM校正地形),并以分贝表示. 每个像素中位数复合材料都是为相同的时间窗口建造的,并按原生的10米像素大小输出,这与光学参考网格相吻合.

blocks.en: ALOS PALSAR (L-band SAR)
blocks.zh: ALOS PALSAR(L波段合成孔径雷达)

blocks.en: L-band data were taken from the JAXA ALOS/ALOS-2 PALSAR yearly mosaics ( JAXA/ALOS/PALSAR/YEARLY/SAR ), which provide HH and HV backscatter that has been ortho-rectified and slope-corrected 38 . The mosaics were used at their native 25 m pixel size, coarser than the optical grid by a factor of 2.5, and the digital numbers were converted to γ 0 \gamma^{0} in decibels with the standard calibration, γ dB 0 = 10 ​ log 10 ⁡ ( DN 2 ) − 83 , \gamma^{0}_{\mathrm{dB}}=10\log_{10}\!\left(\mathrm{DN}^{2}\right)-83, (1) invalid returns being set to the same − 83 -83 dB floor that the min–max normalization later maps to zero. L-band backscatter penetrates deeper into the canopy than C-band and saturates at higher biomass levels, which makes it a natural complement to Sentinel-2 in the dense, tall stands of the Atlantic Forest, where optical reflectance saturates 24 . Because the PALSAR product is a single annual mosaic by construction, this sensor exists only in the annual configuration, which is one of the reasons the reported experiments are restricted to the annual composite.
blocks.zh: L波段数据取自日本宇宙航空研究开发机构ALOS/ALOS-2 PALSAR年度镶嵌图谱(JAXA/ALOS/PALSAR/YEARLY/SAR),该图谱提供了经整形校正和斜面校正的HH和HV回散器。 镶嵌图按其原生的25米像素大小使用,比光学网格粗糙系数为2.5,数字数字按照标准校准值转换为XQ 0\gamma\\0},XQ dB 0 = 10 log 10\x (DN 2) — 83,\gamma\0\ mathrm{dB\ 10\\\ log 10\!\ left (\mathrm{DN\2\\\ right)-83, (1) 无效的返回设定为与 – 83 - 83 dB 底, 分钟 - max常态后期地图为零 。 L波段后散射器比C波段和饱和物在更高的生物量水平上更深入到树冠中,这使得它成为大西洋森林密集高耸的立面中的哨兵-2的自然补充,在那里光学反射饱和度达到24. 由于PALSAR产品通过构造是单一的一年期马赛克,因此这种传感器只存在于年期配置中,这也是所报告的实验被限制在年期复合体中的原因之一.

blocks.en: ALOS DSM (elevation)
blocks.zh: ALOS DSM(连接)

blocks.en: Terrain context was introduced through the JAXA ALOS World 3D 30 m digital surface model, version 4.1 (AW3D30 v4.1, JAXA/ALOS/AW3D30/V4_1 ), distributed through the GEE catalogue 1 1 1 https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/JAXA_ALOS_AW3D30_V4_1 . AW3D30 is a global DSM derived by down-sampling the 5 m AW3D product generated from ALOS PRISM stereo triplets acquired between 2006 and 2011, with subsequent versions filling residual voids with auxiliary DEMs and correcting known artefacts 42 . Only the DSM band was used, which stores elevation in metres referenced to the EGM96 geoid. The quality band MSK was not used.
blocks.zh: Terrain背景通过JAXA ALOS World 3D 30 m数字表面模型4.1版本(AW3D30 v4.1,JAXA/ALOS/AW3D30/V4_1)引入,通过GE目录1 1 https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/JAXA_ALOS_AW3D30_V4_1分发. AW3D30是一个全球DSM,通过对2006年至2011年收购的ALOS PRISM立体三进制产生的5米AW3D产品进行下采样得到,后续版本用辅助DEM填充剩余空隙,并修正已知的工艺品42. 仅使用了DSM波段,该波段存储高程,以米计,参照EGM96地球仪。 未使用质量带 MSK 。

blocks.en: Unlike Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2 and PALSAR, AW3D30 is a static product, a global mosaic of adjacent, non-overlapping tiles with no useful time series. It was therefore exported without any date filter and with a mosaic rather than median reducer, at its native 30 m pixel size, over exactly the same quadrants as the other sensors.
blocks.zh: 与Sentinel-1,Sentinel-2和PALSAR不同,AW3D30是一种静态产品,由相邻的,不重叠的瓦片组成的全球镶嵌,没有有用的时间序列. 因此,出口时没有任何日期过滤器,而且其原生的30米像素尺寸的马赛克比中位减小器,其四角体与其他传感器完全相同。

blocks.en: The rationale for including elevation is twofold. First, canopy height in the Atlantic Forest region is strongly structured by relief. The tallest remnants concentrate on the steep, humid slopes of the Serra do Mar and Serra da Mantiqueira, while the plateaus carry shorter, more fragmented and more intensively used vegetation, so elevation carries a prior on attainable height that no spectral band conveys. Second, both SAR products are themselves affected by topography, since the local incidence angle modulates backscatter, so an explicit elevation channel lets the fusion module discount the radar branches where relief rather than biomass drives the signal. A third contribution has to be acknowledged. AW3D30 is a surface model derived from optical stereo imagery, so over closed forest it follows the top of the canopy of 2006 to 2011 and not the ground. In a fragmented landscape, the step between a persistent remnant and the surrounding pasture is therefore part of the elevation signal, smoothed by the 30 m sampling, and the branch can draw on this historical canopy signal as well as on the relief. Elevation is also the only modality that is not normalized with statistics estimated from the training set. It is divided by a fixed ceiling of 2,100 m (“Input normalization”), safely above the highest value observed in the study area (2,043 m, in the Mantiqueira quadrant), so that the scaling of this branch does not change if the training set is extended.
blocks.zh: 列入海拔的理由有两个。 首先,大西洋森林地区的树冠高度通过松动来形成强烈的结构. 最高的残留集中在Serra do Mar和Serra da Mantiqueira的陡峭潮湿的山坡上,而高原的植被更短、更支离破碎、使用更密集,因此在可达到的高度上,高地具有先天性,没有光谱带可以传达。 第二,两种合成孔径雷达产品本身都受到地形的影响,因为当地事件角会调制回散,因此一个明确的高射通道让聚变模块对雷达分支进行折扣,因为雷达分支是救济而不是生物量驱动信号的。 必须承认第三项贡献。 AW3D30是光学立体成像衍生出来的表面模型,因此在封闭的森林上,它沿着2006年至2011年的树冠顶部,而不是地面. 在一个零散的地貌中,永久残余物与周围牧场之间的阶梯因此成为高架信号的一部分,由30米的采样平滑下来,树枝既可以借鉴这一历史的树冠信号,也可以吸收松动. 升迁也是没有与从培训中估计的统计数字正常化的唯一方式。 它除以2,100米(“投入正常化”)的固定上限,安全地高于在研究区观察到的最高值(2,043米,在曼蒂凯拉四象限),因此,如果延长培训范围,这一分支的缩放不会改变。

blocks.en: Throughout this paper, the two JAXA products are referred to as ALOS PALSAR (L-band backscatter) and ALOS DSM (elevation), and the abbreviation DSM always denotes the latter.
blocks.zh: 在整个本文中,JAXA的两个产品被称为ALOS PALSAR(L-波段后散射器)和ALOS DSM(elevation),缩写DSM总是表示后者.

blocks.en: MapBiomas forest mask
blocks.zh: 马布比奥斯森林面具

blocks.en: We used the MapBiomas Brazil 10 m land use and land cover collection (Collection 11) 40 for the year 2024, an annual product classified from Sentinel-2 imagery at 10 m resolution. The classes “Forest Formation” (legend code 3), “Mangrove” (legend code 5) and “Wooded Restinga” (legend code 49) were extracted and binarized into a forest/non-forest mask. The “Savanna Formation” class (legend code 4) is not part of the mask, so this step also leaves out the savanna physiognomies of the Cerrado and retains only its forest formations. Because the product is already delivered at 10 m, the mask matches the nominal resolution of the reference grid. It was only aligned to that grid with nearest-neighbour resampling and clipped to the same bounding boxes as the image patches. The mask is stored alongside every patch and plays two roles. It is one of the selection criteria of the patch grid (“Patch extraction”), and it restricts the accuracy assessment to pixels mapped as forest (“Accuracy assessment”).

blocks.en: Dataset construction
blocks.zh: 数据集构建

blocks.en: Patch extraction
blocks.zh: 补丁提取

blocks.en: Patches of 256 × \times 256 pixels at 10 m, a nominal ground footprint of 2,560 × \times 2,560 m, were laid out on a single global , non-overlapping grid (Fig. 1 ), anchored at multiples of 256 pixels of the reference grid. Patches were extracted with no lateral overlap. A grid cell was retained as a patch when it met four conditions. At least 10% of its pixels had a LiDAR height above zero, each of the four predictors covered at least 99% of its area, at least 10% of its pixels were mapped as forest in the MapBiomas mask and, for cells within 15 km of the open ocean, no more than 10% of its pixels were mapped as water. Reference heights above 80 m, which are residual LiDAR noise, were set to no-data. Of the 10,472 cells that met the first condition, 8,982 met the other three. Ten of them were later discarded because their reference height came from a raster that was not a canopy height model, which left 8,972 patches. The ALOS PALSAR and ALOS DSM patches are cut from the upper-left corner of the same footprint. At 25 and 30 m the footprint corresponds to 102.4 and 85.3 pixels, which were rounded to 102 and 85 (Table 1 ), so these two patches stop 10 m short of the right and lower edges of the footprint, less than half a pixel at their own resolution. Examples of training patches are shown in Fig. 2 .

ALOS PALSAR和ALOS DSM的补丁从同一脚印的左上角切开. 在25米和30米时,脚印对应102.4和85.3像素,它们被四舍五入为102和85(表1),因此这两个补丁在脚印的右侧和下侧边缘相差10米处停留,在自己的分辨率下不到半像素. 图2显示了培训补丁的例子。

blocks.en: Training and test split
blocks.zh: 培训和测试分开

blocks.en: The patch extraction procedure yielded 8,972 patches, which together cover about 58,800 km 2 at the nominal patch size and were divided into 7,179 training patches (80.0%) and 1,793 test patches (20.0%). Because the patches are laid out on a single non-overlapping grid, any two patches are disjoint by construction, and a patch assigned to the test set shares no pixel with any training patch. The split also has to represent the full range of canopy height. The patches are dominated by short canopy, so a plain uniform draw of the same number of patches can, by chance, leave the tall forests that matter most for carbon poorly represented in the test set. We therefore selected the test set by Latin Hypercube Sampling (LHS) on the canopy height of the patches.
blocks.zh: 补丁提取程序产生了8,972个补丁,按标称补丁大小共覆盖约58,800 km 2,分为7,179个训练补丁(80.0%)和1,793个测试补丁(20.0%). 由于补丁布置在单一的不重叠网格上,任何两个补丁都会因构造而脱节,分配给测试集的补丁不会与任何训练补丁共享像素. 拆分还必须代表整个树冠高度. 补丁以短树冠为主,因此同样数量补丁的平整划线可以偶然地留下对碳影响最大的高高的森林在测试组中代表不佳. 因此我们选择了拉丁语Hypercube Sampling(LHS)在补丁的树冠高度上设置的测试.

blocks.en: Let m k m_{k} be the median LiDAR canopy height of candidate patch k k , for k = 1 , … , K k=1,\dots,K , and let n n be the number of test patches required, 20% of K K . A one-dimensional Latin hypercube design of n n points in the unit interval is drawn with scipy.stats.qmc.LatinHypercube and a fixed seed. By construction, the design partitions the interval into n n strata of equal probability and places exactly one point in each stratum. Each point is converted into a target height through the empirical quantile function of the m k m_{k} and is then matched to the still-unclaimed patch whose median height is closest to that target, so that no patch is selected twice and every design point is realized by an actual patch. The patches so claimed form the test set and the remainder form the training set, which gives the two sets the same distribution of canopy height. The draw was made on the 8,982 patches of “Patch extraction”, before the ten defective patches were removed. It ignores the position of the patches. Test patches are therefore interspersed with training patches over the whole sampled area, 99% of them share an edge with at least one training patch and no buffer separates the two sets. The test metrics thus measure the error of the model inside the landscapes it was trained on, where neighbouring patches share forest tracts, relief and image acquisitions. The error under extrapolation is assessed separately at the external sites (“External validation sites”).

blocks.en: Validation split
blocks.zh: 校验拆分

blocks.en: From the 7,179 training patches, 20% were held out for validation and early stopping, giving 5,743 patches for gradient updates and 1,436 for validation. The held-out patches are drawn at random with a fixed seed and are used only to monitor the validation loss and to trigger early stopping. They never contribute to gradient updates. Like the test patches, they are interspersed with the patches used for gradient updates, so the validation error that triggers early stopping is not spatially independent of them. No data augmentation was applied. Given a training set of several thousand non-overlapping patches, we preferred to train on the unmodified samples.

blocks.en: Optical branch, the boundary-preserving BPAT-UNet
blocks.zh: 光学分支, 保界的 BPAT- UNet

blocks.en: In a fragmented landscape such as the Brazilian Atlantic Forest, the CHM is dominated by abrupt discontinuities, including forest edges against pasture and cropland, roads, and sharp boundaries of Eucalyptus spp. plantations. Standard encoder-decoder regressors recover spatial detail only through skip connections and tend to oversmooth these transitions, producing a gradual ramp where the reference LiDAR-derived CHM shows a step.
blocks.zh: 在巴西大西洋森林等支离破碎的地貌中,CHM以突然中断为主,包括林缘与牧场和耕地、道路以及Eucalyptus spp.种植园的尖锐边界。 标准编码器-解码器递归器只能通过跳过连接来恢复空间细节,并倾向于过度平移这些过渡,产生一个渐进坡道,其中参考LiDAR衍生的CHM显示一个步骤.

blocks.en: We therefore adopted, for the optical branch, an architecture derived from BPAT-UNet 6 , a boundary-preserving U-Net originally proposed for ultrasound segmentation, where the same difficulty arises. The object of interest has a low-contrast but sharp boundary that convolutional decoders blur. We retain the boundary-supervision principle of that architecture in a simplified, fully convolutional form — the transformer blocks of the original design were replaced by convolutional attention, which is more economical at the patch sizes used here.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们为光学分支采用了一种从BPAT-UNet 6中衍生出来的建筑,这是最初为超声波分解而提出的一种保界的U-Net,那里也会出现同样的困难。 兴趣对象有低调但尖锐的边界,其演化解码器模糊. 我们保留了该建筑的边界监督原则,采用简化的,完全的转录形式——原设计的变压器块被转录注意力所取代,在此处使用的补丁尺寸上更经济.

blocks.en: The branch begins with a band-adaptation layer, a 1 × \times 1 convolution that projects the ten Sentinel-2 bands into a fixed four-channel representation, so that the same backbone can be instantiated for any number of input bands. The encoder is a sequence of double 3 × \times 3 convolution blocks (each with batch normalization and ReLU) separated by max-pooling, with widths 64 → 128 → 256 → 512 → 1024 64\rightarrow 128\rightarrow 256\rightarrow 512\rightarrow 1024 ; the bottleneck therefore operates at 1/16 of the input resolution (16 × \times 16 pixels for a 256 × \times 256 patch). The decoder mirrors it with transposed convolutions, concatenation of the corresponding encoder feature and a further double convolution, and a final 1 × \times 1 convolution projects the output to the C = 64 C=64 channels that enter the fusion module, or to the single channel of the height logit in the optical baseline (E1), which has no fusion module.

blocks.en: The boundary-preserving behaviour comes from a boundary enhancement module (BEM, Fig. 4 ) inserted after each encoder stage. Given a feature tensor 𝐗 ∈ ℝ C × H × W \mathbf{X}\in\mathbb{R}^{C\times H\times W} , the module estimates a single-channel edge response with a depthwise 3 × \times 3 convolution (one filter per channel, followed by batch normalization and ReLU) and a 1 × \times 1 projection, and converts it into a soft boundary map: 𝐁 = σ ⁡ ( 𝒟 ⁡ ( 𝐗 ) ) ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) 1 × H × W , \mathbf{B}=\sigma\big(\mathcal{D}(\mathbf{X})\big)\in(0,1)^{1\times H\times W}, (6) where 𝒟 \mathcal{D} denotes the depthwise edge detector and σ \sigma the logistic function. In parallel, a standard 3 × \times 3 convolution block produces an enhanced version ℰ ⁡ ( 𝐗 ) \mathcal{E}(\mathbf{X}) of the same features. The two are combined residually, 𝐗 ′ = 𝐗 + ℰ ⁡ ( 𝐗 ) ⊙ 𝐁 , \mathbf{X}^{\prime}=\mathbf{X}+\mathcal{E}(\mathbf{X})\odot\mathbf{B}, (7) so that the enhancement is applied selectively where an edge is detected and the response is left untouched in homogeneous canopy. The residual formulation means the module can be ignored by the optimizer (by driving 𝐁 \mathbf{B} to zero) if a given stage does not benefit from it, which makes it safe to stack at every scale. Because the BEM acts on the encoder features that are subsequently passed through the skip connections, the sharpened boundary information reaches the decoder at every resolution rather than being reconstructed from the bottleneck alone.

blocks.en: Auxiliary branches
blocks.zh: 辅助分支

blocks.en: The Sentinel-1, ALOS PALSAR and ALOS DSM branches are lightweight U-Nets (double 3 × \times 3 convolution blocks with batch normalization and ReLU, max-pooling for downsampling and transposed convolutions with skip connections for upsampling), with a base width of 32 channels and a final 1 × \times 1 convolution projecting to the same C = 64 C=64 channels. Their depth is derived from the native patch side so that the bottleneck never degenerates. A downsampling stage is added while the current side is even and would remain at or above four pixels after halving, up to a maximum of four stages and with a minimum of one. This yields four stages for the Sentinel-1 branch (256 px, bottleneck of 16 px), one stage for the ALOS PALSAR branch (102 px, bottleneck of 51 px, where the rule stops because 51 is odd) and one stage for the ALOS DSM branch (85 px, bottleneck of 42 px, the minimum of one stage, since 85 is already odd). In the decoder, the upsampled tensor is padded to the size of the corresponding skip feature before concatenation, which restores the 85 px side of the DSM branch after its bottleneck is upsampled to 84 px. The shallow depth of the two coarser branches matches the small number of native pixels they carry, about 10,400 for ALOS PALSAR and 7,200 for the ALOS DSM, against 65,536 for the 10 m sensors.

blocks.en: Simple concatenation treats all modalities as equally informative everywhere, which is a poor assumption here. The relative value of L-band backscatter is high where the optical signal saturates, in tall closed-canopy stands, and low over sparse or recently disturbed forests, where Sentinel-2 is already discriminative. We therefore adopted a gated fusion mechanism, in which a global descriptor of all modalities modulates the contribution of each of them, channel by channel (Fig. 4 ).
blocks.zh: 简单的调和将所有方式都视为各地的同等信息,这在这里是一个差的假设. L波段反散射器的相对价值很高,在光学信号饱和度高的闭合层立体和低矮的稀疏或最近扰动的森林中,哨兵-2已经具有歧视性。 因此,我们采用了一个封闭式聚变机制,其中所有模式的全球描述符按频道调整每个模式的贡献(图4)。

blocks.en: Training
blocks.zh: 培训

blocks.en: All models were implemented in PyTorch and trained end-to-end from random initialization on a single GPU (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 with 32 GB of VRAM). No branch was pre-trained. The ten-band Sentinel-2 input and the SAR inputs have no counterpart in natural-image datasets, and the boundary-preserving backbone described in “Optical branch, the boundary-preserving BPAT-UNet” has no ImageNet checkpoint, so transfer learning was not applicable. The loss is the mean absolute error between the predicted and the reference height in normalized units, ℒ = 1 | Ω | ​ ∑ ( i , j ) ∈ Ω | σ ⁡ ( ℓ i ​ j ) − h i ​ j h max | , \mathcal{L}=\frac{1}{|\Omega|}\sum_{(i,j)\in\Omega}\left|\sigma(\ell_{ij})-\frac{h_{ij}}{h_{\max}}\right|, (11) where ℓ i ​ j \ell_{ij} is the logit of pixel ( i , j ) (i,j) (“Overall architecture”), h i ​ j h_{ij} its reference height and Ω \Omega the set of pixels of the patch that enter the loss. Because a height of zero also marks the absence of LiDAR data (“LiDAR reference data”), pixels with a reference height of exactly zero are excluded from Ω \Omega in the patches where they make up at least 5% of the pixels, where they are typically gaps in the LiDAR coverage, and are kept in the other patches, where they are typically open ground. The same rule applies to the validation error. Pixels outside the forest mask, such as pastures, crops, tree plantations and urban areas, are not excluded, so the network is trained on every land cover, whereas the accuracy assessment is restricted to forest (“Accuracy assessment”). MAE was preferred over MSE because of its lower sensitivity to the extreme heights that occasionally survive the LiDAR noise filtering, and because it is directly interpretable in metres after rescaling.

The same hyper-parameters and the same random seed were used in all experiments, so that the comparison between sensor configurations is not confounded by different parameter tuning. The second stage of configuration E5, a fine-tuning that starts from the weights of the first stage rather than from random initialization, is described in “Experimental design”.

blocks.en: Experimental design
blocks.zh: 实验设计

blocks.en: We compared five sensor configurations, all trained on the annual 2024 composites (Table 3 ). The series isolates, in turn, the contribution of Sentinel-1, of ALOS PALSAR and of the ALOS DSM, always on top of the same optical baseline. When a branch is switched off, the network is instantiated with fewer branches and the gated fusion module is resized accordingly. The optical baseline (E1, N = 1 N=1 ) has neither fusion module nor regression head, and its BPAT-UNet maps the Sentinel-2 patch directly to the height logit. Everything else is held constant, including the patches, the split, the normalization strategy and the hyper-parameters.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了五个传感器配置,它们都接受了2024年年度复合材料(表3)的培训。 系列依次隔离了ALOS PALSAR和ALOS DSM的哨兵1号的贡献,它们总是在同一光学基线之上. 当一个分支被关闭时,网络被即时化,分支减少,并相应调整闸门聚变模块的大小. 光学基线(E1,N = 1 N = 1)既无聚变模块,也无回归头,其BPAT-UNet将哨兵-2补丁直接映射到高度日志. 其他的都保持不变,包括补丁,分解,正常化策略和超参数.

blocks.en: The four-branch configuration (E5), which produced the dataset, was trained in two stages. The first stage is the training described above, on the São Paulo patches alone. In the second stage, its weights were fine-tuned on the 7,179 training patches of São Paulo together with 252 patches of 256 × \times 256 pixels cut with overlapping windows from other airborne LiDAR surveys, namely 105 patches from four sites of the GEO-TREES network in São Paulo, 132 patches from the Veracel station in southern Bahia, where the same 66 windows were paired with composites of two different years, and 15 patches from the 2017 survey of Jaraguá do Sul, in Santa Catarina. Fine-tuning used a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , ten times lower than the base rate of the first stage and held constant after the same 5-epoch warm-up, together with the batch size, the early-stopping rule and the normalization constants of the first stage. The validation patches were drawn from the combined set as in “Validation split”, except that the GEO-TREES and Santa Catarina patches and the 66 Veracel patches of the earlier composite were always used for gradient updates, which gave 5,987 patches for gradient updates and 1,444 for validation. The lowest validation MAE was reached at the end of the first epoch of fine-tuning, and training stopped after 25 further epochs without improvement. Because the step from the three-branch configurations to E5 adds both a sensor and these patches, the ablation isolates the contribution of each sensor only up to E4, and the effect of the fine-tuning on the test patches is reported separately (“Accuracy across sensor configurations”). The fine-tuning patches of Santa Catarina also cover the survey of Jaraguá do Sul used for external validation (“External validation sites”).
blocks.zh: 制作数据集的四分支配置(E5)分两个阶段进行训练. 第一阶段是上述仅关于圣保罗补丁的培训。 在第二阶段,它的重量在圣保罗的7,179个训练补丁上进行了微调,加上252个补丁256××时256像素被其他空中LiDAR调查的重叠窗口切割,即圣保罗的GEO-TREES网络四个站点的105个补丁,巴伊亚南部的Veracel站的132个补丁,同一个66个窗口与两个不同年份的复合材料对齐,圣卡塔琳娜的2017年Jaraguá do Sul调查的15个补丁. 微调采用10−4 10^{-4}的学习率,比第一阶段的基率低十倍,并在同一个5个时代的热身后保持不变,再加上批量大小,早停规则和第一阶段的正常化常数. 验证补丁是从“Validation discription”中的组合集合中抽取的,只是GEO-TREES和Santa Catarina补丁以及早先复合材料中的66个Veracel补丁一直用于梯度更新,这给5,987个梯度更新补丁和1,444个验证补丁。 在第一个微调时代末期达到最低的验证MAE,再过25个世纪后再无改进地停止了训练. 由于从三分支配置到E5的阶梯同时增加了一个传感器和这些补丁,衰减只将每个传感器的贡献隔离到E4,微调对测试补丁的影响另行报告(“传感器配置的精确度”). Santa Catarina的微调补丁还包括用于外部验证的Jaraguá do Sul的调查(“外部验证站”)。

blocks.en: The choice of the optical branch was assessed on the optical baseline, the only configuration in which the whole network is the architecture under test. In addition to the BPAT-UNet, E1 was trained with two encoder–decoder networks of the segmentation-models-pytorch library, a U-Net 32 and an MA-Net 13 , both with a ResNet-50 encoder 15 initialized with ImageNet weights 10 and truncated after four downsampling stages, so that, as in the BPAT-UNet, the bottleneck operates at 1/16 of the input resolution, and with decoders of 512, 256, 128 and 64 channels. The three networks were trained anew for this comparison with the same patches, split, normalization, loss, optimizer and learning-rate schedule, and with an early-stopping patience of 10 epochs instead of 25, and were evaluated as in “Accuracy assessment”. Only the BPAT-UNet starts from random initialization, so the comparison gives the two reference networks the advantage of pre-training.
blocks.zh: 光学分支的选择在光学基线上被评估,整个网络的唯一配置是正在测试的架构. 除BPAT-UNet外,E1还接受了分块-模型-平板电脑库的两个编码器-解码器网络,一个U-Net 32和一个MA-Net 13的训练,两者都有一个ResNet-50编码器15,以ImageNet重量10初始化,并在四个下采样阶段后被截断,因此,与BPAT-UNet一样,瓶颈在输入分辨率的1/16运行,以及512,256,128和64个频道的解码器. 对这三个网络进行了新的培训,以便与同样的补丁、拆分、正常化、损失、优化和学习率时间表进行比较,并以10个纪元而不是25个纪元的早期耐心来评价,并被评价为“准确性评估”。 只有BPAT-UNet是从随机初始化开始的,所以比较使得两个参考网络获得了预训的优势.

blocks.en: Table 3 : Experimental design. Five sensor configurations, all trained on the annual 2024 Sentinel-2 composite. In the fusion configurations (E2 to E5), every branch contributes 64 feature maps to the gated cross-modal fusion. Configuration E5 was then fine-tuned with 252 patches from other airborne LiDAR surveys (“Experimental design”).
blocks.zh: 表3:实验设计. 5个传感器配置,均接受过2024 Sentinel-2年度复合材料的培训. 在聚变配置(E2至E5)中,每个分支为门式跨模式聚变贡献64个特征图. 然后,对配置E5进行了精细调整,从其他空中LiDAR测量(“实验设计”)中抽取了252个补丁。

blocks.en: Inference
blocks.zh: 推论

blocks.en: Wall-to-wall prediction was performed tile by tile, on 762 tiles of 5,120 × \times 5,120 pixels at 10 m. The network was not applied to a whole tile at once. A window of 256 × \times 256 pixels, the size used in training, was moved over each Sentinel-2 tile with an overlap of 50% between consecutive windows, so that the global descriptor of the gated fusion (“Gated cross-modal fusion”) is always computed over the footprint it saw in training. For each window, the Sentinel-1 window was cut at the same position, and the ALOS PALSAR and ALOS DSM windows of 102 and 85 pixels were cut on their own grids from the position that corresponds to the upper-left corner of the Sentinel-2 window, as in training. All inputs were normalized with the constants stored in the checkpoint, and the logistic activation and the rescaling by h max h_{\max} were applied to the logits. The overlapping predictions were then averaged with the weights of a two-dimensional Hann window, which gives little weight to the border of each window and avoids seams between windows. No margin was predicted around the tiles, so a pixel at the edge of a tile has image context on one side only. The resulting height map was written as a GeoTIFF that inherits the geotransform and the coordinate reference system of the input tile. The forest mask was applied to the prediction at 10 m. The masked height was then aggregated to 30 m by spatial averaging, on a grid anchored globally so that the cells coincide between tiles, and Equation 12 was applied to the aggregated height. A 30 m pixel receives a value when at least half of the 10 m pixels inside it are forest, and its carbon density then refers to its forest part.
blocks.zh: 墙对墙的预测由瓦片进行,在762块5,120×\time5,120像素10米处进行. 网络并未同时应用于整块瓷砖. 在每个哨兵-2的瓦片上移动了一个256×时256像素的窗口,连续窗口之间的重叠率为50%,因此,门式聚变(“Gated cross-modle union”)的全球描述器总是在培训中看到的足迹上计算。 对于每个窗口,哨兵1号窗口在同一位置被切开,102像素和85像素的ALOS PALSAR和ALOS DSM窗口在自己的网格上从对应哨兵2号窗口左上角的位置被切开,如同训练一样. 所有输入都与储存在检查站的常数正常化,后勤启动和重缩(h max h_{\max})适用于日志。 重叠的预测随后与二维汉恩窗口的权重进行平均,对每个窗口的边框没有多少权重,避免了窗口之间的缝合. 瓦片周围没有预测到边距,因此一个瓦片边缘的像素只有一侧的图像上下文. 由此产生的高度图被写成继承输入瓦片的地球变形和坐标参考系统的GeoTIFF. 森林面具被应用到10米的预测中. 然后,将遮盖的高度按空间平均值加在一起,在固定在全球的网格上,使细胞在瓦片之间重合,将方程式12应用于总高度。 30米像素得到一个值,当它内部的10米像素至少有一半是森林,它的碳密度然后指它的森林部分.

blocks.en: Accuracy assessment
blocks.zh: 准确性评估

blocks.en: Model accuracy was assessed on the held-out test patches defined in “Training and test split”, which share no pixel with the training patches of the São Paulo grid. For each test patch, the predicted CHM and the LiDAR-derived CHM were intersected pixel by pixel and stacked across all patches into two paired vectors.
blocks.zh: 对“训练和试验拆分”中定义的搁置试验补丁进行了模型精度评估,该补丁与圣保罗网格的训练补丁没有像素。 对于每个测试补丁,预测的CHM和LiDAR衍生的CHM被像素相交,并堆叠在所有补丁上,形成两个对齐的矢量.

blocks.en: Two filters were applied before computing the statistics. First, only pixels mapped as forest in the MapBiomas 2024 mask were retained, that is, pixels classified as Forest Formation , Mangrove or Wooded Restinga (“MapBiomas forest mask”), which removes croplands, pastures, water and built-up areas from the comparison. Second, only pixels with a reference LiDAR height above zero were kept, which discards the cells without LiDAR data, the bare ground and the unvegetated surfaces that survive inside the mask. The metrics therefore describe the error over standing forest canopy and do not include the error at the gaps and bare patches that a height of zero would represent.
blocks.zh: 在计算统计数据之前使用了两个过滤器。 首先,只保留了MapBiomas 2024面具中被划为森林的像素,即被归类为森林形成、红树林或木质休息的像素(“MapBiomas森林面具”),这些像素将耕地、牧场、水和建成区从比较中删除。 第二,只保留了参考LiDAR高度高于0的像素,这种像素将没有LiDAR数据的细胞,裸露的地面和在面具内存活的未植被表面丢弃. 因此,衡量标准描述了常住林冠上的误差,不包括零高度所代表的缺口和赤补丁上的误差。

blocks.en: From the resulting paired vectors we computed the root mean squared error (RMSE), the mean absolute error (MAE), the bias, the coefficient of determination ( R 2 R^{2} ) of an ordinary least-squares fit of prediction against reference and the concordance correlation coefficient (CCC) 21 , using scikit-learn and SciPy . Bias is defined as the mean of LiDAR minus predicted height, so that positive values denote underestimation, and it is also reported as a percentage of the mean reference height. Agreement was visualized with two-dimensional density plots based on hexagonal binning, with equal axes, the 1 to 1 line and the fitted regression line. Residuals were further stratified into reference-height classes and the bias was reported per class.
blocks.zh: 从产生的对偶向量中,我们利用scikit-learn和SciPy计算出根平均方差(RMSE)、平均绝对差(MAE)、偏差、一个普通最小方位的确定系数(R 2 R^{2})和一致相关系数(CCC)21。 bias被定义为LiDAR减去预测高度的平均值,因此正值表示低估,它也被报告为平均参考高度的一个百分比. 协议以二维密度地块以六边形的二进制为基础,具有等轴、1至1线和装配的回归线。 残余物被进一步分级为参考高度类别,并报告每个类别存在偏差。

blocks.en: Aboveground carbon density model
blocks.zh: 地面碳密度模型

blocks.en: We used forest inventory data from 124 field plots of 900 m 2 (30 by 30 m) allocated in restoration plantings, naturally regenerated forests and conserved and degraded forest remnants across the Atlantic Forest. Sixty-one plots are restoration plantings, 26 are naturally regenerated forests, 21 are conserved remnants and 16 are degraded remnants. Most of them lie in the State of São Paulo (114 plots), with five in Rio de Janeiro and five in southern Bahia, and they cover the three main phytophysiognomies of the region, namely seasonal semi-deciduous forest (50 plots), the transition to savanna (46) and ombrophilous forest (28) (Fig. 1 ). The field protocol required all woody individuals with a diameter at breast height (DBH) equal to or above 5 cm to be recorded, with measurements of DBH and total height. Botanical samples were collected for each species within each plot and later identified by taxonomic specialists, with voucher specimens deposited at the ESA Herbarium of the University of São Paulo. All plots were georeferenced with dual-frequency GNSS, which ensures high positional accuracy. The forest inventory data were processed to fix or remove data inconsistencies such as typing errors and misspellings, and aboveground biomass was then estimated at tree and plot level with the allometric equation of Chave et al. Super .
blocks.zh: 我们使用了124块900米(30乘30米)的田间地块的森林清单数据,用于恢复植树造林、自然再生的森林以及养护和退化的大西洋森林残余物。 61块地块为恢复植树造林,26块为自然再生林,21块为养护残留,16块为退化残留. 其中大多数位于圣保罗州(114块地),里约热内卢有5块,巴伊亚州南部有5块,它们覆盖了该地区的三个主要植物学,即季节性半阴性森林(50块地)、向草原(46块)和乌布罗菲卢斯森林(28块)(图1)。 场协议要求记录乳房高度(DBH)直径等于或大于5厘米的所有木质个体,并测量DBH和总高度. 在每个地块内收集了每个物种的植物样本,后来由分类学专家确定,凭证标本存放于圣保罗大学欧空局草本馆。 所有地块都与双频全球导航卫星系统进行地理参照,确保了高定位精确度。 对森林清单数据进行了处理,以纠正或消除数据不一致之处,例如打字错误和打错,然后用Chave等人的全分方程对地面生物量进行树和地块水平估计。 超级。

blocks.en: Every plot was covered by airborne laser scanning, 93 of them with remotely piloted aircraft systems and the remaining 31 with airborne surveys. One campaign used the GatorEye Lite system, a customized DJI Matrice 300 RTK carrying a Zenmuse L1 sensor together with a multispectral sensor, between 17 and 27 August 2022, and represents, to our knowledge, the largest collection of LiDAR data from remotely piloted aircraft in the Atlantic Forest. The Zenmuse L1 has a field of view of 70 ∘ , a maximum range of 190 m at 10% reflectance and a maximum multiple-return rate of 480,000 points per second. Three returns per pulse were recorded with a sampling rate of 240 kHz in non-repetitive scanning mode, and the flights were conducted between 90 and 110 m above ground level, at a ground speed of 8 to 10 m s -1 and with a spacing of 20 to 25 m between flight lines, which gives a side overlap of about 82% at 100 m above ground level. A second campaign, in 2023, used a DJI Matrice 350 RTK with a Zenmuse L2 sensor, which has a field of view of 70 ∘ , a maximum range of 250 m at 10% reflectance and a maximum multiple-return rate of 1,200,000 points per second. Two returns per pulse were stored, with a sampling rate of 240 kHz in non-repetitive scanning mode, at 100 m above ground level, a ground speed of 10 m s -1 and a side overlap of 50%. The remaining plots were covered by airborne surveys flown by partner companies with a RIEGL LMS-Q680i full-waveform scanner, with a field of view of 45 ∘ and a pulse repetition rate of 400 kHz, at a mean altitude of 620 m, a side overlap of 30% and a ground speed of 62 m s -1 .
blocks.zh: 每块地块都由空中激光扫描覆盖,其中93块为遥控飞机系统,其余31块为空中勘测. 在2022年8月17日至27日期间,一项运动使用了GatorEye Lite系统,这是定制的DJI Matrice 300 RTK,携带Zenmuse L1传感器和一个多光谱传感器,并代表着从大西洋森林遥控飞机上收集的最大LiDAR数据。 Zenmuse L1的视野为70 QQ,最大范围为190米,反射率为10%,最大多返回率为48万分/秒. 在非重复扫描模式下记录了三次每脉冲返回,采样率为240kHz,飞行在地面高度90至110米之间,地面速度为8至10米s-1,飞行线间距为20至25米,在地面高度100米处使侧重叠约82%. 2023年的第二次活动使用了DJI Matrice 350 RTK,带有Zenmuse L2传感器,其视野为70 QQ,最大范围为250米,反射率为10%,最高多返回率为每秒1200 000点. 每脉冲存储了两次返回,在非重复扫描模式下取样率为240kHz,地面高度100米,地面速度为10m s-1,侧重叠率为50%. 其余的地块由伙伴公司用RIEGL LMS-Q680i全波式扫描仪进行空中勘测,视场为45%,脉冲重复率为400千赫,平均高度为620米,侧重叠率为30%,地面速度为62米秒-1。

blocks.en: The point clouds were processed exactly as the LiDAR reference data of this study (“LiDAR reference data”), so that the height used to calibrate the carbon model and the height the network is trained to predict are defined in the same way. For every plot, we then computed the top canopy height (TCH) as the mean of the 1 m CHM pixels falling inside the plot, which is the plot-level counterpart of the surface the model predicts. Plot biomass was converted into aboveground carbon density (AGCD), in Mg C ha -1 , with a carbon fraction of 0.47 17 . Because the two sides of the relationship must describe the same forest, every plot was required to have its LiDAR acquisition and its field inventory less than one year apart.
blocks.zh: 点云的处理与本研究的LiDAR参考数据("LiDAR参考数据")完全相同,因此用于校准碳模型的高度和网络的预测高度被训练成相同的定义. 对于每一个地块,我们然后计算顶冠高度(TCH)作为1米CHM像素掉在地块内的平均值,这是模型预测的地表的地层对应物. Plot生物量在Mg C ha-1中转化为地面碳密度,碳分量为0.47 17。 由于双方关系必须描述同一个森林,因此每块地块都必须有它的LiDAR收购和它的野外存货相隔不到一年.

blocks.en: Carbon density was then related to canopy height by the power law AGCD = a ​ TCH b . \mathrm{AGCD}=a\,\mathrm{TCH}^{\,b}. (12) Equation 12 is what converts the canopy height predicted by the network into aboveground carbon density. The carbon density of a pixel therefore carries three sources of uncertainty, namely the coefficients of the curve, the scatter of individual stands around it, which includes the allometric error of plot biomass, and the error of the predicted height. The first two are propagated into the uncertainty layers of the dataset and the third is treated separately (“Uncertainty of the carbon density map”).
blocks.zh: 碳密度随后通过动力法AGCD = a TCH b 与树冠高度有关. \ mathrm{ AGCD}\ ,\ mathrm{ TCH}\ , b}(12) 方程式12是将网络预测的树冠高度转换为地面碳密度的方法。 因此,像素的碳密度带有三种不确定性来源,即曲线系数,个体的散落在周围,其中包括地块生物量的超度误差,以及预测高度的误差。 前两个部分被传播到数据集的不确定性层中,第三个部分被分别处理(“碳密度图的不确定性”)。

blocks.en: Uncertainty of the carbon density map
blocks.zh: 碳密度图的不确定性

blocks.en: The uncertainty of the carbon layer was propagated pixel by pixel from Equation 12 with a first-order Taylor expansion, the delta method 45 , as in the error propagation of plot-based biomass estimates 8 . Two sources of error enter it, the uncertainty of the coefficients a a and b b , which is shared by every pixel, and the residual scatter of individual stands around the curve, which contains the structural difference between plot categories and the random part of the allometric error of plot biomass. Because that scatter grows with height, Equation 12 was refitted on the 124 plots with a residual standard deviation that is a power function of height, AGCD j = a ​ TCH j b + ε j , ε j ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , σ 2 ​ ( TCH j ) ) , σ ⁡ ( TCH ) = s 0 ​ TCH δ , \mathrm{AGCD}_{j}=a\,\mathrm{TCH}_{j}^{\,b}+\varepsilon_{j},\qquad\varepsilon_{j}\sim\mathcal{N}\!\left(0,\,\sigma^{2}(\mathrm{TCH}_{j})\right),\qquad\sigma(\mathrm{TCH})=s_{0}\,\mathrm{TCH}^{\,\delta}, (13) with AGCD j \mathrm{AGCD}_{j} in kg m -2 and a a , b b , s 0 s_{0} and δ \delta estimated jointly by maximum likelihood, as gnls with a varPower variance function does in the nlme package of R 26 . The fit also gives the covariance matrix 𝚺 θ \boldsymbol{\Sigma}_{\theta} of 𝜽 = ( a , b ) ⊤ \boldsymbol{\theta}=(a,b)^{\top} . blocks.en: External validation sites
blocks.zh: 外部验证站点

blocks.en: Because the network is trained almost entirely on São Paulo patches (“The State of São Paulo as reference window”), it does not capture the Atlantic Forest region’s full variability in forest structure. Since the held-out test patches of São Paulo cannot capture the extrapolation error, we assessed it directly using two airborne LiDAR datasets outside São Paulo.
blocks.zh: 由于该网络几乎完全接受圣保罗补丁(“圣保罗州作为参考窗口”)的培训,因此无法反映大西洋森林区域在森林结构方面的充分变化。 由于圣保罗被搁置的测试补丁无法捕捉到推断错误,我们直接使用圣保罗以外的两个空中LiDAR数据集来评估.

blocks.en: Both sites come from the Sustainable Landscapes Brazil project ( https://www.paisagenslidar.cnptia.embrapa.br/ ), which distributes surveys over Brazilian sites at no cost. The first is the survey of the Serra do Conduru State Park, in the municipalities of Uruçuca, Itacaré and Ilhéus, in southern Bahia 11 . The forests in these regions provide the clearest example of the canopy stature that São Paulo lacks, with mature stands storing of the order of 390 Mg ha -1 of aboveground biomass and secondary stands recovering biomass at rates among the highest reported for the Neotropics 5 , 31 . The flights were carried out between 16 and 23 December 2015 with an Optech Orion M300 scanner at a mean altitude of 850 m and a field of view of 12 ∘ , which gave a mean return density of 94.5 points per square metre, of which 46.2 are first returns. The point cloud is delivered already classified, in SIRGAS 2000 UTM zone 24S. We derived the CHM with the same procedure used for the calibration data (“LiDAR reference data”), at 1 m resolution, and aggregated it to the 10 m reference grid by spatial averaging, which yielded 4,549 ha of valid canopy height at the nominal pixel size.
blocks.zh: 这两个地点都来自巴西可持续景观项目(https://www.paisagenslidar.cnptia.embrapa.br/),该项目免费在巴西各地分发调查资料。 首先是在巴伊亚州南部的乌鲁丘卡、伊塔卡雷和伊尔赫乌斯市对Serra do Conduru国家公园的调查。 这些区域的森林是圣保罗缺乏的树冠地位最明显的例子,成熟的树台储存着大约390mg ha-1的地面生物量,二级树台以Neotrophics 5,31报告的最高速率恢复生物量. 飞行时间为2015年12月16日至23日,搭载一台Optech Orion M300扫描机,平均高度850米,视野12 QQ,给出的平均返回密度为每平方米94.5点,其中46.2是首发返回. 点云已经分类,在SIRGAS 2000 UTM 区24S. 我们以1米分辨率的校准数据( " LiDAR参考数据 " )的相同程序得出了CHM, 并按空间平均值将其归集为10米参考网格,在名义像素大小下得出4,549公顷的有效树冠高度。

blocks.en: The second is the survey of Jaraguá do Sul and Massaranduba, in Santa Catarina 36 , about 1,000 km to the south of Conduru and close to the southern limit of the dense rainforest. It was flown on 26 August 2017 with an Optech ALTM 3100 scanner at a mean altitude of 850 m, a field of view of 15 ∘ , a scanning frequency of 40 Hz and 70% overlap between flight lines, which gave a mean return density of 54.05 points per square metre over twelve blocks covering 510 ha, delivered already classified in SIRGAS 2000 UTM zone 22S. The block sits on the eastern escarpment of the Serra do Mar and its ground elevation ranges from about 70 to 920 m over a horizontal distance of roughly 3 km, a relief gradient steeper than that of almost any calibration patch. The CHM was derived and aggregated exactly as for Conduru, which yielded 516 ha of valid canopy height at the nominal pixel size. The 510 ha quoted above is the area of the survey blocks, and the two figures are not directly comparable, because at this latitude the true ground area of a pixel is about 11% smaller than its nominal 100 m 2 (“LiDAR reference data”).
blocks.zh: 其二是位于圣卡塔琳娜36号的Jaraguá do Sul和Massaranduba的勘测,距离康杜鲁以南约1000公里,靠近密集雨林的南部极限. 它于2017年8月26日搭载一台Optech ALTM 3100扫描仪,平均高度850米,视野为15 QQ,扫描频率为40赫兹,飞行线重叠率为70%,这给出了在覆盖510公顷的12个区块上每平方米54.05点的平均回报密度,已经交付到SIRGAS 2000 UTM区22S. 该区块坐落在Serra do Mar河的东侧河口上,其地面高度在大约3公里的横向距离上大约在70至920米之间,救济梯度比几乎所有校准补丁都陡峭。 CHM与Conduru完全相同,后者在名义像素大小上产生了516公顷的有效树冠高度。 上面引用的510 ha是勘测区块面积,这两个数字并不直接可比,因为在这个纬度上,像素的真实地面面积比其名义的100 m 2 (“LiDAR参考数据”)小约11%.

blocks.en: The two sites are displaced towards taller canopy than the calibration window, and they are displaced in different ways. Half of the forest of Conduru stands above 19.3 m and half of the forest of Jaraguá do Sul above 18.5 m, compared with 15.7 m in the São Paulo patches. Conduru also carries the wider distribution, with a 95th percentile of 27.9 m and a tallest pixel of 44.6 m, while Jaraguá do Sul is narrower and shorter at the top, with a 95th percentile of 25.3 m. The two therefore place the model outside the conditions under which it was fitted along different axes, namely stature at Conduru and relief and latitude at Jaraguá do Sul. Figure 5 compares the three distributions over the pixels that enter the respective assessments.
blocks.zh: 这两个地点被迁移到比校准窗口高的树冠,他们以不同的方式迁移。 康杜鲁的森林有一半在19.3米以上,贾拉瓜杜苏尔的森林有一半在18.5米以上,而圣保罗地段的森林有15.7米. 康杜鲁的分布范围也较宽,其95百分位数为27.9米,最高的像素为44.6米,而南雅拉瓜(Jaraguá do Sul)的顶部更窄更短,其95百分位数为25.3米. 因此,两者将模型置于不同轴线上,即康杜鲁和南贾拉瓜的救济和纬度。 图5比较了输入相应评估的像素的三种分布。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Distribution of LiDAR canopy height in the São Paulo patches and in the two external validation sites. Each band is a histogram in classes of 1 m built over the pixels that fall inside the MapBiomas forest mask and carry a height above zero. The interquartile range is shaded and the median is marked, and the median, the 95th percentile and the number of pixels are reported on the right of each band. The vertical bar gives the share of pixels falling in a class of 1 m, the horizontal axis is truncated at 35 m and the bands are ordered by median height. The forest mask is what makes the comparison one of canopy rather than of land cover.
blocks.zh: 图5:圣保罗补丁和两个外部验证站点的LiDAR冠高分布. 每个波段是1米级的直方图,建在落于MapBiomas森林面具内的像素上,并携带高度高于0的高度. 中位数范围为阴影和中位数,中位数,九十五百分位数和像素数则报告在每个带的右侧. 垂直条给出1米级中落下的像素份额,水平轴为35米的截线,带由中位高度排列. 森林遮盖是比较树冠而不是土地覆被的原因。

blocks.en: For each site, the predictors were assembled in Google Earth Engine with the same bands, filters, and reducers used for the calibration data (“Satellite imagery”), over the footprint of the corresponding LiDAR mosaic, with the compositing window moved as close to the date of the survey as the archives allow. Sentinel-2 surface reflectance is available in the Earth Engine catalogue only from 28 March 2017, so at both sites the Sentinel-2 and Sentinel-1 composites are built from the acquisitions between 2017 and 2019, and the ALOS PALSAR mosaic is that of the survey year, 2017 at Jaraguá do Sul and 2015 at Conduru. At Conduru the optical and C-band imagery is therefore two to four years more recent than the LiDAR, which adds forest growth and disturbance to the error measured there.
blocks.zh: 每个网站的预测器都用相同的波段、过滤器和校准数据所用的减压器(“卫星图象”)在相应的LiDAR镶嵌物的足迹上组装在Google Earth Earth Earth Engine中,堆肥窗口在档案允许的范围内移动,接近调查日期。 2017年3月28日起地球引擎目录中才有哨兵-2表面反射功能,因此在两地的哨兵-2和哨兵-1复合材料都是由2017年至2019年间的收购而建的,而ALOS PALSAR mosaic是勘测年份,2017年在南雅拉瓜和2015年在康杜鲁. 因此,在Conduru,光学和C波段的图像比LiDAR更近二至四年,它增加了森林生长和扰动,增加了所测误差。

blocks.en: The four-branch model (E5) was applied to the two sites, and each prediction was compared with its LiDAR CHM pixel by pixel, with the metrics of “Accuracy assessment”. The two sites differ in their relation to the training data. The survey of Serra do Conduru shares no pixel with any training or fine-tuning patch, and the nearest fine-tuning patches, those of the Veracel station, lie about 190 km to the south. The survey of Jaraguá do Sul, in contrast, is covered by the 15 fine-tuning patches of Santa Catarina, which were cut from the same LiDAR canopy height model (“Experimental design”), so the error measured there is not independent of the training data, and only Serra do Conduru measures the error of the model outside the areas it was trained on.
blocks.zh: 将四个分支模型(E5)应用于这两个地点,每个预测都按像素与其LiDAR CHM像素进行比较,并采用“准确性评估”的衡量标准。 这两个网站在培训数据方面有所不同。 对Serra do Conduru的勘测没有带任何训练或微调补丁的像素,最近的微调补丁,即维拉克尔站的补丁,位于南面约190公里处. 相比之下,Jaraguá do Sul的勘测由Santa Catarina的15个微调补丁覆盖,这些补丁是从同一个LiDAR树冠高度模型("实验设计")中剪下来的,因此所测出的错误并不独立于训练数据,只有Serra do Conduru在它所训练的地区之外测量模型的错误.

blocks.en: Comparison with an existing canopy height product
blocks.zh: 与现有树冠高度产品进行比较

blocks.en: We benchmarked our maps against the global canopy height product of Meta and the World Resources Institute, in its second version 23 . The product maps canopy height worldwide at a native resolution of 1 m from very-high-resolution RGB imagery, with a self-supervised vision transformer backbone and a convolutional decoder trained on airborne LiDAR 43 . It is the finest global canopy height map available at the moment.
blocks.zh: 我们用Meta和世界资源研究所的第二版全球树冠高度产品作为基准。 产品以1米的本地分辨率从甚高分辨率的RGB图像绘制出全球树冠高度图,其中有一个自我监督的视觉变压器骨干和一个在空中LiDAR 43上训练的革命解码器。 这是目前最好的全球冠状高度图。

blocks.en: The product was downloaded over the footprint of every test patch and aggregated from its native 1 m grid to the 10 m reference grid by spatial averaging, which is the same operator used to bring the LiDAR CHM to that grid (“LiDAR reference data”). Prediction, product, and reference therefore share one grid and one set of pixels. Both maps were then compared with the LiDAR CHM over exactly the same pixels, with the metrics of “Accuracy assessment”, so that the two are evaluated as a paired sample rather than on separate footprints.
blocks.zh: 该产品在每一个测试补丁的足迹上下载,并按空间平均从原生的1米网格到10米的参考网格进行汇总,这是将LiDAR CHM带入该网格的同一操作员(“LiDAR参考数据”)。 因此,预测、产品和参考共享一个网格和一组像素。 之后将这两幅地图与LiDAR CHM进行了完全相同的像素比较,并采用了“准确性评估”的衡量标准,以便将这两幅地图作为配对样本而不是在单独的足迹上加以评价。

blocks.en: Carbon accounting by natural domain
blocks.zh: 按自然领域分列的碳核算

blocks.en: In 2025, the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics released an ecological regionalization of the national territory, Domínios e Regiões Naturais Terrestres dos Biomas do Brasil 16 . It nests three levels, the biome, the natural domain, and the natural region, and its boundaries follow geology, geomorphology, soils, climate, and vegetation typology instead of administrative limits. Brazil is divided into 52 natural domains and 271 natural regions. The Atlantic Forest holds ten natural domains, six of them in the continental interior and four in the coastal system, together with 57 natural regions. We adopted this layer because it partitions the Atlantic Forest along the same physical axes that govern forest structure. The carbon map of “Aboveground carbon density model” was intersected with the ten domains on the 30 m grid.
blocks.zh: 2025年,巴西地理和统计研究所发布了国家领土的生态区域化报告,Domínios e Regißes Naturais Terrestres dos Biomas do Brasil 16。 它依次依次依次为地质学,地貌学,土壤,气候,植被类型等三个层次,分别是生物群落,自然域,自然区,其边界也依次为地理,地貌,土壤,气候,植被类型而非行政限制. 巴西分为52个自然领域和271个自然区域。 大西洋森林拥有10个自然域,其中6个位于大陆内陆,4个位于沿海系统,还有57个自然区. 我们采用了这个层,因为它沿着管理森林结构的同样物理轴分割大西洋森林。 “地表碳密度模型”的碳图与30米网格上的10个域相交。

blocks.en: Data Records
blocks.zh: 数据记录

blocks.en: The dataset is deposited at Zenodo under https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24233662 14 . All raster layers are GeoTIFF files in geographic coordinates (EPSG 4326, WGS 84), delivered as tiles that follow the grid of the Sentinel-2 mosaics used for prediction. Tiles are internally tiled and compressed with the DEFLATE algorithm and carry overviews, so that they can be read directly by GDAL-based software and by cloud-optimized GeoTIFF clients. Table 4 lists the records, and Figure 6 shows the canopy height and the carbon density layers over the whole Atlantic Forest region.
blocks.zh: 数据集存于泽诺多https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24233662 14 (英语). 所有光栅层都是地理坐标(EPSG 4326,WGS 84)中的GeoTIFF文件,作为瓦片随用于预测的哨兵-2马赛克的网格而交付. 梯子在内部用DEFLATE算法进行瓦片和压缩,并携带概览,以便直接通过基于GDAL的软件和云优化GeoTIFF客户端读取. 表4列出了记录,图6显示了整个大西洋森林区域的树冠高度和碳密度层。
