blocks.zh: 表4:数据集记录。 所有光栅都是EPSG 4326中的GeoTIFF. 整数层以10缩放,使用无数据值65535,浮点层使用−9999-9999.

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Canopy height and aboveground carbon density of the Brazilian Atlantic Forest in 2024. (a) Canopy height (m) and (b) aboveground carbon density of record 2, both drawn over the Atlantic Forest region, filled in black, in an Albers equal-area projection. The insets show the same layers close to their native resolution at (c, e) the coast of Bertioga, in São Paulo, where the tall forest of the Serra do Mar escarpment gives way to the lower restinga and mangrove forests of the coastal plain, and (d, f) the Estação Veracel, a private reserve of lowland rainforest in southern Bahia.
blocks.zh: 图6 2024年巴西大西洋森林的冠状高度和地上碳密度. (a) 圆冠高度(m)和(b) 记录2的地面碳密度,两者均在大西洋森林区域上空划出,用黑色填充,以阿尔伯斯等域投影。 在圣保罗的Bertioga海岸(c、e), Serra do Mar escarpment的高山森林让位于沿海平原的下休宁加和红树林,以及(d、f) 巴伊亚南部低地雨林的私人保留地Estação Veracel, 印地安人与土著分辨率接近。

blocks.en: Record 1. Canopy height at 10 m. One GeoTIFF per tile with the canopy height predicted by the four-branch model (configuration E5) from the annual 2024 composites, in metres, stored as unsigned 16-bit integers scaled by 10 (one unit equals 0.1 m) with a no-data value of 65535. The layer is masked to the MapBiomas forest classes, so that pixels outside native forest are no-data.
blocks.zh: 记录 1. Canopy高度为10米. 从2024年的复合材料中,每瓦1个带有4个分支模型(配置E5)预测的树冠高度的GeoTIFF,以米计,作为无符号的16位整数存储,缩放10(一个单位等于0.1米),无数据值为65535. 该层被遮掩到MapBiomas森林课上,因此本土森林外的像素是无数据的.

blocks.en: Record 2. Aboveground carbon density at 30 m. One GeoTIFF per tile with aboveground carbon density in Mg C ha -1 , obtained by aggregating the 10 m height to 30 m by spatial averaging and converting it with the power law of Equation 12 . Values are stored as unsigned 16-bit integers scaled by 10 (one unit equals 0.1 Mg C ha -1 ) with a no-data value of 65535, and the layer is masked to the MapBiomas forest classes, so that pixels outside native forest are no-data. This is the layer on which the carbon stocks of Table 8 were computed.
blocks.zh: 记录 2. 地面碳密度为30米。 Mg C ha-1中每块地上碳密度为1个GeoTIFF,通过空间平均将10米高度加到30米并按方程式12的动力定律转换而获得。 值被存储为无符号的16位整数,缩放为10(一个单位等于0.1 Mg C ha - 1),无数据值为65535,层被遮掩到Map Biomas森林类,因此本土森林外的像素是无数据. 这是计算表8碳储存量的层次。

blocks.en: Record 3. Standard error of aboveground carbon density at 30 m. One GeoTIFF per tile of record 2, on the same grid and over the same forest pixels, with the standard error of the carbon density of each pixel given by Equation 14 , in Mg C ha -1 . Values are stored as unsigned 16-bit integers scaled by 10 with a no-data value of 65535, and the scale factor and the unit are written in the band metadata, so that GDAL-based software reads the physical value directly. The file metadata hold the coefficients of Equation 12 used in the product ( a = 0.089 a=0.089 and b = 1.645 b=1.645 ), the covariance matrix of the refit, and the variance function of Equation 13 , so that each tile documents how it was computed. The relative standard error is 100 times this value divided by record 2. The standard error excludes the error of the predicted height (“Uncertainty of the carbon density map”) and is therefore a lower bound. Because the coefficient term is shared by all pixels, the pixel variances must not be summed as independent to obtain the uncertainty of a stock, for which record 4 should be used.
blocks.zh: 记录 3. 30米处地面碳密度的标准误差。 同一网格上和同一森林像素上,每块记录2的砖块各有一个GeoTIFF,每块像素的碳密度标准误差由方程式14给出,以Mg C ha-1表示. 数值被存储为无符号的16位整数,缩放为10,无数据值为65535,尺度因子和单位被写入波段元数据,因此基于GDAL的软件直接读取物理值. 文件元数据持有产品中使用的方程式12的系数(a = 0.089 a = 0.089和b = 1.645 b = 1.645),复数的共变矩阵,以及方程式13的差函数,这样每个瓦片都记录其计算方式. 相对标准错误是该值的100倍除以记录2. 标准误差排除了预测高度的误差(“碳密度图的不确定性”),因此是一个下限. 由于系数名词由所有像素共同使用,因此不能将像素差异相加为独立,以获得一个股票的不确定性,为此应使用记录4.

blocks.en: Record 4. Mean carbon density and its uncertainty at 1 km. One GeoTIFF on a grid of 1/120 of a degree with eleven bands, stored as 32-bit floating point with a no-data value of − 9999 -9999 . The bands hold the mean carbon density of the forest pixels of each cell, its standard error and relative standard error with the coefficient error shared by all pixels (Equation 16 ) and, for comparison, with independent errors between pixels, the coefficient term of each of the two versions, the residual and within-cell terms, the standard deviation of the pixel values inside the cell and the number of forest pixels. The mean and all the uncertainty terms are in Mg C ha -1 , the terms being stored as standard errors, that is, as the square roots of the terms of Equation 16 and not as variances, and the relative errors are in per cent. Each band carries its name, unit, and description in its metadata. The correlated version is the one to use for stocks. A JSON file and a text file with the parameters of the uncertainty model accompany records 3 and 4.
blocks.zh: 记录 4. 1公里的平均碳密度及其不确定性。 1个GeoTIFF在一个具有11个波段的1/120学位的网格上,存储为32位浮点,无数据值为−9999-9999. 频段持有每个单元格的森林像素的平均碳密度,其标准误差和与所有像素共享的系数误差(方程16)的相对标准误差,为比较起见,与像素之间的独立误差,两个版本中每个版本的系数术语,残值和细胞内术语,细胞内像素值的标准偏差和森林像素数. 平均值和所有不确定性的术语以Mg C ha-1表示,这些术语被存储为标准错误,即作为方程式16术语的方根而非差异,相对错误以百分比表示. 每个波段在其元数据中标注其名称、单位和描述。 相关版本用于库存。 一个JSON文件和一个带有不确定性模型参数的文本文件随附记录3和4.

blocks.en: Record 5. Canopy height at 10 m without the forest mask. The prediction of record 1 before the MapBiomas forest mask is applied, in the same format, so that every pixel holds a canopy height, including pastures, croplands, forest plantations, urban areas and water. It is delivered in 762 tiles that cover the whole Atlantic Forest region, 119 more than record 1, which keeps only the tiles with forest. The tiles extend beyond the limit of the region and over the sea and should be clipped to the area of interest. Inside the forest mask, record 5 is identical to record 1. The accuracy reported under “Technical Validation” refers to forest pixels only, so heights outside native forest were not validated.
blocks.zh: 记录5. 山冠高10米 没有森林面具。 在MapBiomas森林面具之前对记录1的预测应用了同样的格式,这样每个像素都拥有一个树冠高度,包括牧场,耕地,森林种植园,城市地区和水. 它以762块覆盖整个大西洋森林区域的瓦片交付,比纪录1多119块,只保留有森林的瓦片. 瓷砖超出区域界限,横跨海洋,应剪接至有关区域。 森林面具内部,5号记录与1号记录相同. 在“技术验证”项下报告的准确性仅指森林像素,因此,本土森林以外的高度没有得到验证。

blocks.en: Record 6. Aboveground carbon density at 30 m without the forest mask. Record 5 aggregated to 30 m and converted with Equation 12 as in record 2, in the same format and on the same tiles as record 5. Inside the forest mask, it differs from record 2 only in the 30 m pixels that are partly forest, where record 2 averages only the forest pixels of the 10 m grid. Because Equation 12 was calibrated on forest plots, outside native forest record 6 gives the carbon of a native stand of the mapped height and not an estimate of the carbon of plantations, crops or urban trees, and the standard errors of record 3 do not apply to it. It is distributed so that the carbon stock can be recomputed under another definition of forest.
blocks.zh: 记录6。 地面碳密度为30米,没有森林面具。 5号记录总和为30米,与2号记录相同,与5号记录相同,并用12号方程式转换。 在森林面具内部,它与记录2只有部分为森林的30米像素有差异,记录2平均只有10米网格的森林像素. 由于第12号方程式是在森林地块上校准的,因此在原生森林记录6之外,给出了地图高度的原生立方的碳,而不是对种植园,作物或城市树木的碳的估计,第3号记录的标准错误不适用于它. 它的分布使得碳储量可以根据森林的另一种定义重新计算.

blocks.en: Technical Validation
blocks.zh: 技术鉴定

blocks.en: The validation proceeds from the calibration region outwards. We first report the accuracy of the five sensor configurations on the held-out test patches of São Paulo, the structure of the residuals by height class and the effect of aggregation to 30 m. We then apply the selected model to two airborne LiDAR surveys outside São Paulo, compare it with the global canopy height product of Meta over the same pixels, document the fit and the residual structure of the height-to-carbon relationship, propagate its error into the carbon map from the pixel to the whole Atlantic Forest region, and finally test whether the carbon map reproduces the structural gradient of that region across an independent regionalization.
blocks.zh: 审定从校准区向外进行. 我们首先报告圣保罗的搁置测试补丁上的5个传感器配置的准确性,按高度等级划分的剩余部分的结构以及集合到30米的效果. 然后,我们将选定的模型应用于圣保罗以外的两次空中LiDAR测量,用相同的像素与Meta的全球树冠高度产物进行比较,记录高度对碳关系的合适性和剩余结构,将其错误从像素传播到整个大西洋森林区域的碳图中,最后测试碳图是否通过独立的区域化复制该地区的结构梯度.

blocks.en: Accuracy across sensor configurations
blocks.zh: 传感器配置的精确度

blocks.en: Table 5 reports RMSE, MAE, bias, R 2 R^{2} and CCC for the five sensor configurations, computed on the held-out test patches described in “Accuracy assessment” and restricted to MapBiomas forest pixels with a reference LiDAR height above zero. E1 to E4 share the annual 2024 composite, the same patches, the same split and the same hyper-parameters, so the differences between them are attributable to the set of sensors alone, whereas the row of E5 also carries the effect of the fine-tuning with the 252 extra patches (“Experimental design”).
blocks.zh: 表5报告了RMSE、MAE、偏差、R 2 RXX2}和CCC的五个传感器配置,这些配置是根据“准确性评估”中描述的搁置测试补丁计算出来的,并限于MapBiomas森林像素,参考LiDAR高度高于0。 E1至E4共用了每年2024年的复合材料,相同的补丁,相同的拆分和相同的超参数,因此它们之间的差异可归因于传感器集单独,而E5行还带有与252额外补丁的微调效果(“实验设计”).

blocks.en: Table 5 : Accuracy comparison of canopy height models (CHM) predicted from different sensor configurations, all with the annual 2024 composite, evaluated against airborne LiDAR reference height within the MapBiomas forest mask. Configuration E5 includes the fine-tuning with 252 patches from other airborne LiDAR surveys (“Experimental design”).
blocks.zh: 表5:根据不同传感器配置预测的树冠高度模型(CHM)的精确性比较,均与2024年年度复合材料对照Map Biomas森林面具内的空中LiDAR参考高度进行评估. E5配置包括利用其他空中LiDAR测量(“实验设计”)中的252个补丁进行微调。

blocks.en: The optical baseline (E1) reached RMSE = 3.39 m, MAE = 2.53 m, R 2 R^{2} = 0.708 and CCC = 0.830. Adding the C-band branch (E2) produced the largest single gain of the series, lowering RMSE by 0.13 m and MAE by 0.10 m and raising R 2 R^{2} to 0.732. The two branches added on top of that configuration behaved differently from one another. ALOS L-band backscatter (E3) lowered RMSE by a further 0.12 m and MAE by 0.10 m, almost as much as the C-band branch, and raised R 2 R^{2} to 0.749. Elevation (E4) lowered RMSE and MAE by 0.08 m each and raised R 2 R^{2} to 0.745, but it also shifted the pooled bias from − - 0.04 to +0.35 m, the largest of the series, so the DSM branch reduces the dispersion of the error less than the L-band branch and adds a systematic underestimation.
blocks.zh: 光学基线(E1)达到RMSE = 3.39米,MAE = 2.53米,R 2 R^{2}= 0.708,CCC = 0.830. 加入C波段分支(E2)产生了系列最大的单增益,将RMSE降低0.13米,MAE降低0.10米,并将R 2 R^{2}提升到0.732. 这两个分支在结构之上增加了不同的表现。 ALOS L-波段反散射器(E3)将RMSE又降低了0.12米,MAE降低了0.10米,几乎与C-波段分支相同,并将R 2 R^{2}提高到0.749. 梯级(E4)将RMSE和MAE各降低0.08米,并将R 2 R^{2}提升到0.745米,但也将集合偏差从−-0.04改为+0.35米,是系列中最大的,因此DSM分支比L波段分支减少误差的分散,并增加了系统性的低估.

blocks.en: The four-branch model (E5) was the best configuration in RMSE, MAE, R 2 R^{2} and CCC, with RMSE = 3.05 m, MAE = 2.26 m, R 2 R^{2} = 0.763 and CCC = 0.867, and its pooled bias of +0.19 m, or 1.2% of the mean reference height, is larger than those of E1 to E3 and smaller than that of E4. Relative to the optical baseline, this amounts to a reduction of 9.8% in RMSE and of 10.7% in MAE. A small part of this gain comes from the fine-tuning rather than from the sensors. Before fine-tuning, the four-branch model reached RMSE = 3.08 m, MAE = 2.28 m, R 2 R^{2} = 0.760 and CCC = 0.868 over the same test pixels, so the fine-tuning lowered RMSE and MAE by about 0.02 m, and the three sensors added to Sentinel-2 account for a reduction of 9.1% in RMSE and of 9.9% in MAE with respect to E1. At that stage the four-branch model improved on E2 by 0.18 m in RMSE, close to the sum of the gains of E3 and E4 (0.19 m), so L-band backscatter and elevation carry largely complementary information. The improvement comes from combining a signal that responds to canopy structure with a description of the relief that modulates both the backscatter and the attainable height.
blocks.zh: 四分支模型(E5)是RMSE,MAE,R 2 R^{2}和CCC中最好的配置,RMSE = 3.05 m,MAE = 2.26 m,R 2 R^{2} = 0.763和CCC = 0.867,其集合偏差为+0.19 m,即平均参考高度的1.2%,大于E1到E3,小于E4. 与光学基线相比,RMSE减少9.8%,MAE减少10.7%。 这一收益的一小部分来自微调而不是传感器。 在微调前,四分支型号在相同的试验像素上达到RMSE = 3.08米,MAE = 2.28米,R 2 R^{2} = 0.760,CCC = 0.868,因此微调将RMSE和MAE降低约0.02米,加到Sentinel-2的3个传感器占RMSE的下降9.1%,而MAE对E1的下降9.9%. 在那个阶段,四个分支模型在RMSE中改进了E2上的0.18米,接近E3和E4(0.19米)的增益之和,因此L波段后向散射和高程携带了大部分互补信息. 改进来自将一个响应树冠结构的信号与调制背散子和可实现高度的解脱的描述结合起来.

blocks.en: The comparison of Supplementary Table S1 , which trains the optical baseline with three architectures under identical conditions, supports the choice of the BPAT-UNet for the optical branch. The BPAT-UNet reached the lowest error, with RMSE = 3.35 m, MAE = 2.50 m, R 2 R^{2} = 0.714 and CCC = 0.835, against 3.38 m, 2.52 m, 0.711 and 0.835 for the MA-Net and 3.47 m, 2.60 m, 0.694 and 0.825 for the U-Net, although the U-Net had the smallest pooled bias, − - 0.06 m against +0.17 m. Its advantage over the MA-Net is small, 0.03 m in RMSE, but it was obtained without pre-training and with a third fewer parameters (43.6 against 64.9 M), whereas the U-Net, the lightest of the three (36.4 M), was the least accurate. The three networks share the height-dependent bias described below, overestimating canopy below 10 m by 1.6 to 1.9 m and underestimating canopy above 40 m by 17.4 to 17.9 m, so this compression of the upper tail does not depend on the architecture. As these networks were trained anew with a shorter patience, the BPAT-UNet row does not reproduce exactly the E1 row of Table 5 (3.35 against 3.39 m in RMSE).
blocks.zh: 辅助表S1在相同条件下对光学基线和三种架构进行训练的比较,支持光学分支选择BPAT-UNet. BPAT-UNet达到最低误差,RMSE = 3.35米,MAE = 2.50米,R 2 R^{2} = 0.714,CCC = 0.835,而MA-Net为 3.38米,2.52米,0.711和0.835,U-Net为 3.47米,2.60米,0.694和0.825,虽然U-Net的集合偏差最小,− - 0.06米对+0.17米. 它相对于MA-Net的优势很小,在RMSE中为0.03米,但是在没有经过预先训练的情况下获得的,其参数少了三分之一(43.6对64.9 M),而三个网中最轻的U-Net(36.4 M)则最不准确. 这三个网络共享以下描述的高度依赖偏差,高估10米以下的树冠1.6至1.9米,低估40米以上的树冠17.4至17.9米,因此上尾的这种压缩并不依赖于建筑结构. 由于这些网络以更短的耐心接受了新的培训,BPAT-UNet一行并不完全复制表5的E1一行(RMSE为3.35对3.39米).

blocks.en: We stratified the residuals of the four-branch model (E5) by reference LiDAR height class (Fig. 7 ). The near-zero pooled bias of this model proves to be the residue of two large and opposite errors. Short canopy is systematically overestimated by 1.25 m in the 0 to 10 m class, which amounts to 18.7% of the class mean height, and by 0.25 m (1.6%) in the modal 10 to 20 m class, which alone holds 58.1% of the evaluated pixels. Underestimation then grows monotonically above 20 m, reaching +2.00 m (8.6%) at 20 to 30 m, +6.47 m (19.9%) at 30 to 40 m, and +16.38 m (36.3%) above 40 m.
blocks.zh: 我们通过参考LiDAR高度等级(图7)对四分支模型(E5)的残存进行分级. 这个模型的近零集合偏差被证明是两个大反差的残余. 0至10米级的短冠被系统高估1.25米,相当于班次平均高度的18.7%;10至20米级的单冠被0.25米(1.6%),仅持有58.1%的评价像素. 低估后,单体生长在20米以上,20至30米时达到+2.00米(8.6%),30至40米时达到+6.47米(19.9%),40米时达到+16.38米(36.3%).

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Systematic error of the four-branch model (E5) by reference canopy height derived from LiDAR. Bias is the mean of LiDAR minus predicted height, so bars above zero, in red, denote underestimation and bars below zero, in blue, denote overestimation. The right-hand axis gives the same bias as a percentage of the class mean height, the label above or below each bar repeats that percentage together with the class RMSE, diamonds mark the median residual and error bars span ± \pm 1 SD of the per-pixel residual within the class. The lower panel gives the number of test pixels in each class and its share of the total.
blocks.zh: 图7:从LiDAR推导出的参考树冠高度对四分支模型(E5)的系统误差. Bias是LiDAR减去预测高度的平均值,因此0以上的条,用红色表示低估,零以下的条,用蓝色表示高估. 右侧轴给出与类平均高度百分比相同的偏差,上下各栏的标签重复该百分比与类RMSE,钻石标记中位残值和误差栏跨类内每像素残值的±\pm 1 SD. 下面板给出了每个类的测试像素数量及其在总数中的份额.

blocks.en: Part of the pixel-level error is spatial noise rather than a systematic offset, and it disappears when the two maps are read at a coarser resolution. Aggregating both the prediction and the reference to a 30 m grid lowers RMSE from 3.05 to 2.58 m, which is a fall from 19.4% to 16.4% of the mean reference height, and MAE from 2.26 to 1.90 m. The agreement statistics improve accordingly, with R 2 R^{2} rising from 0.763 to 0.810 and CCC from 0.867 to 0.896, and the median absolute error falling from 1.74 to 1.48 m. The bias, on the other hand, is practically untouched, +0.19 m at 10 m against +0.18 m at 30 m, as it must be, since averaging removes dispersion and not a systematic offset (Fig. 8 ). About 16% of the error at the native resolution is therefore spatially uncorrelated and cancels within a 30 m pixel.
blocks.zh: 部分像素级误差是空间噪声而不是系统性的抵消,当两幅地图在较窄的分辨率下读取时就会消失. 综合预测和参考的30米网格将RMSE从3.05米降至2.58米,这是平均参考高度的19.4%降至16.4%,MAE从2.26降至1.90米。 协议统计相应改善,R 2 R^{2}从0.763升至0.810,CCC从0.867升至0.896,中间绝对误差从1.74米降至1.48米. 另一方面,这种偏差实际上没有改变,10米时+0.19米,30米时+0.18米,因为平均消除分散,而不是系统抵消(图8)。 因此,原生分辨率大约16%的误差与空间无关,并在30m像素范围内取消.

blocks.en:

blocks.zh: 校准区域以外的外部验证

blocks.en: The four-branch model (E5) was applied to the two external sites of “External validation sites”, each with the composites described there. Table 6 reports the overall metrics and Figure 9 shows the reference height against the predicted height at each site. As explained there, only Serra do Conduru is independent of the training data, since the fine-tuning patches of Santa Catarina cover Jaraguá do Sul.
blocks.zh: 四个分支模型(E5)适用于“外部验证站”的两个外部站点,每个站点都有其中所述的复合材料。 表6报告总的衡量标准,图9显示每个地点的参考高度与预测高度的对比。 正如上面所解释的,只有Serra do Conduru独立于培训数据,因为Santa Catarina的微调补丁覆盖了Jaraguá do Sul。

blocks.en: Table 6 : External validation of the four-branch model (E5) at the two sites of “External validation sites”, evaluated pixel by pixel on the 10 m grid. Bias is the mean of the LiDAR reference minus the prediction, so positive values denote underestimation.

blocks.en: At Serra do Conduru, the comparison covers 454,849 pixels with a mean reference height of 17.82 m. RMSE is 4.56 m, which is 25.6% of that mean, MAE is 3.55 m (20.0%), and the pooled bias is +2.49 m (14.0%), with a median bias of +2.30 m. blocks.en: Table 7 stratifies the residuals by reference height class at the two sites and, for comparison, in the São Paulo test patches. At Serra do Conduru, the bias is positive in every class, from +0.13 m (2.2%) between 0 and 10 m to +2.23 m (13.9%) between 10 and 20 m, +5.37 m (22.8%) between 20 and 30 m and +10.40 m (32.4%) between 30 and 40 m. At Jaraguá do Sul it is negative in the two lower classes, − - 5.75 m ( − - 80.3%) between 0 and 10 m and − - 2.89 m ( − - 17.8%) between 10 and 20 m, and positive in the two upper ones, +0.92 m (4.0%) between 20 and 30 m and +7.66 m (24.0%) between 30 and 40 m. At both sites, the class median stays within 0.25 m of the class mean, except in the 30 to 40 m class of Jaraguá do Sul, which holds 192 pixels and where the two differ by 0.52 m, and the residual standard deviation stays between 2.40 and 4.57 m.

blocks.en: Comparison with the global canopy height product of Meta and WRI
blocks.zh: 与Meta 和 WRI 全球冠高产品比较

blocks.en: Over the 53,755,301 test pixels where our prediction and the external product both have valid data, the four-branch model reached RMSE = 3.06 m (19.1%), MAE = 2.27 m, bias = +0.21 m (1.3%), R 2 R^{2} = 0.748 and CCC = 0.857. The product of Meta and WRI reached RMSE = 7.09 m (44.2%), MAE = 5.75 m, bias = +5.14 m (32.1%), R 2 R^{2} = 0.381 and CCC = 0.414, with a 90th percentile of the absolute error of 11.13 m (Fig. 10 ). The error of the global product is thus more than twice ours in RMSE and more than two and a half times ours in MAE, and most of it is systematic. Its mean predicted height over these pixels is 10.9 m against 16.0 m in the LiDAR, an underestimation of about a third of the mean canopy height.
blocks.zh: 在53,755,301个测试像素上,我们的预测和外部产物都有有效的数据,四个分支模型达到RMSE=3.06米(19.1%),MAE=2.27米,偏差=+0.21米(1.3%),R 2 R^{2}=0.748,CCC=0.857. Meta和WRI的产物达到RMSE = 7.09 m(44.2%),MAE = 5.75 m,偏差=+5.14 m(32.1%),R 2 R^{2}=0.381,CCC=0.414,绝对误差为11.13 m的90%(图10). 因此,全球产品的错误在RMSE中是我们的两倍以上,在MAE中是我们的两倍半以上,而且大部分是系统的。 它在这些像素上的平均预测高度是10.9米,而LiDAR中为16.0米,这是对平均树冠高度约三分之一的低估.

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Comparison with the global canopy height product of Meta and WRI over the test patches of São Paulo. Panel (a) is the four-branch model and panel (b) is the external product, both against the same LiDAR reference and over the same 53,755,301 pixels, restricted to the MapBiomas forest mask. Hexagon colour is the number of pixels per hexagon, the dashed line is the 1 to 1 line and the solid line is the linear fit.
blocks.zh: 图10:在圣保罗测试补丁上与Meta和WRI的全球冠高产品进行比较. 面板(a)是四分支型号,面板(b)是外部产品,既针对相同的LiDAR参考,也针对相同的53,755,301像素,仅限于Map Biomas森林面具. 六边形颜色是每六边形的像素数,虚线是1到1线,实线是线性吻合.

blocks.en: Carbon density as a function of canopy height
blocks.zh: 树冠高度的碳密度函数

blocks.en: The 124 inventory plots span top canopy heights from 0.7 to 24.0 m and carbon densities from 0.06 to 19.3 kg m -2 , with means of 11.7 m and 5.70 kg m -2 . Equation 12 was adopted with a = 0.089 a=0.089 and b = 1.645 b=1.645 , and over these plots it explains 76% of the variance of plot carbon density, with an RMSE of 1.90 kg m -2 , an MAE of 1.43 kg m -2 and a bias of + + 0.11 kg m -2 (Fig. 11 ).
blocks.zh: 124个库存地块的顶棚高度从0.7米到24.0米,碳密度从0.06公斤到19.3公斤至2公斤不等,用量为11.7米和5.70公斤至2米。 采用方程式12时采用一个=0.089 a=0.089和b=1.645 b=1.645,在这些地块上解释地块碳密度差异的76%,RMSE为1.90kg m-2,MAE为1.43kg m-2,偏差为++0.11kg m-2(图11)。

blocks.en: Figure 11 : Aboveground carbon density (AGCD) as a function of top canopy height (TCH) for the 124 inventory plots, with the plots coloured by category. The solid line is Equation 12 with a = 0.089 a=0.089 and b = 1.645 b=1.645 , and the box gives these coefficients together with the goodness-of-fit statistics evaluated on the plots, all in kg m -2 , where 1 kg m -2 equals 10 Mg C ha -1 . Bias is the mean of observed minus predicted carbon density, so a positive value means that the curve lies below the plots. The number of plots in each category is given in the legend.
blocks.zh: 图11:表层碳密度(AGCD)作为124个清单地块的顶冠高度(TCH)的一种函数,地块按类别排列. 固态线为方程式12,其a=0.089 a=0.089和b=1.645 b=1.645,框中给出了这些系数,加上在地块上评估的适切性统计数据,均以kg m-2为单位,其中1 kg m-2等于10 Mg C ha-1. 比亚斯是观测到的负预测碳密度的平均值,因此正值意味着曲线位于地块下方. 每个类别的地块数量在传说中给出.

blocks.en: Uncertainty of carbon density from the pixel to the whole region
blocks.zh: 从像素到整个区域的碳密度的不确定性

blocks.en: The fit of Equation 13 gave a = 0.0898 a=0.0898 (SE 0.0186) and b = 1.650 b=1.650 (SE 0.080), with R 2 = 0.758 R^{2}=0.758 , an RMSE of 1.90 kg m -2 and a residual standard deviation of σ ⁡ ( TCH ) = 0.094 ​ TCH 1.197 \sigma(\mathrm{TCH})=0.094\,\mathrm{TCH}^{\,1.197} kg m -2 . The residual term accounts for 97.3% of the variance of the pixels and the coefficients for the remaining 2.7% (Equation 14 ). This high proportion of residual variance is typical in AGCD modelling. It indicates that while the mean height-to-biomass relationship is firmly established (yielding low coefficient uncertainty), individual pixels of the same height still exhibit natural variations in biomass due to unobserved factors like wood density and species composition.
blocks.zh: 配方13的配方给出了=0.0898 a=0.0898 (SE 0.0186)和b=1.650 b=1.650 (SE 0.080),其中R 2=0.758 R^{2σ0.758,RMSE为1.90kg mi -2,剩余标准差=0.094 TCH 1.197\sigma (\mathrm{TCH})=0.094\,\mathrm{TCH}1.197} kg m-2. 剩余术语占像素差异的97.3%,占剩余2.7%的系数(方程式14 )。 这种高比例的剩余差异在AGCD建模中是典型的. 它表明,虽然平均高度与生物量的关系已经牢固确立(产生低系数不确定性),但由于木材密度和物种组成等未观察到的因素,同一高度的单个像素在生物量方面仍然显示出自然变化。

blocks.en: The standard error of a pixel grows with canopy height, from 6.5 Mg C ha -1 at 5 m to 14.9 Mg C ha -1 at 10 m and 34.4 Mg C ha -1 at 20 m, while the relative standard error falls from 52% to 38% and 28% (Fig. 12 b), because the residual grows with an exponent of 1.197 and the curve with one of 1.645. Over all forest pixels, the median standard error is 21.1 Mg C ha -1 , with 5th and 95th percentiles of 4.6 and 39.6 Mg C ha -1 , and the median relative standard error is 33.1%, with percentiles of 26.8 and 60.1%. Only 2.66% of the forest pixels have a mapped height above the tallest plot, 24.0 m, where the standard error extrapolates the variance function.
blocks.zh: 像素的标准误差随树冠高度而增长,从5米时的6.5Mg C ha - 1到10米时的14.9Mg C ha - 1到20米时的34.4Mg C ha - 1,而相对标准误差则从52%下降到38%和28%(图12 b),因为残差的增速为1.197,曲线的增速为1.645. 在所有森林像素上,中位标准误差为21.1 Mg C ha-1,第5和第95百分位数为4.6和39.6 Mg C ha-1,中位相对标准误差为33.1%,百分位数为26.8%和60.1%。 森林像素中只有2.66%的高度分布在最高的地块24.0米以上,标准误差推断出差异函数.

blocks.en: Because the standard error depends only on height, its map mirrors the canopy height of Fig. 6 (Fig. 12 a). The highest values, above 30 Mg C ha -1 , occur in the tall continuous forests of the Serra do Mar in São Paulo and Paraná, of the coast of Santa Catarina and of southern Bahia, and the lowest in the shorter seasonal forests of western São Paulo and Mato Grosso do Sul, where the relative error is in turn the highest. For the whole Atlantic Forest region, the standard error of the mean density is 2.4 Mg C ha -1 , or 3.5%, almost all of it from the coefficients, which corresponds to about 68 Tg C on the stock of Table 8 .
blocks.zh: 由于标准误差只取决于高度,其地图反射了图6(图12 a)的树冠高度. 最高值高于30 Mg C ha-1, 出现在圣保罗和巴拉那、圣卡塔琳娜海岸和巴伊亚南部的Serra do Mar高地连续森林中,最低值出现在圣保罗西部和南马托格罗索的季节性森林中,相对误差是最高的。 对整个大西洋森林区域,平均密度的标准误差为2.4 Mg C ha-1,即3.5%,几乎全部来自系数,对应于表8的种群约68 Tg C.

blocks.en: Figure 12 : Standard error of the aboveground carbon density (AGCD) map. (a) Standard error of the 30 m pixels (Equation 14 , record 3), averaged over the forest pixels of display cells of about 1.2 km. Grey marks the parts of the region where forest covers less than 3% of the cell. (b) Standard error of a pixel as a function of canopy height, solid within the height range of the 124 plots and dashed beyond the tallest plot (24.0 m), with dots giving the relative standard error at 5, 10 and 20 m. The error of the predicted height is not included.
blocks.zh: 图12:地面碳密度(AGCD)图的标准误差。 (a) 30米像素的标准误差(方程式14,记录3),平均在大约1.2公里的显示细胞的森林像素上。 Grey标记了森林覆盖面积不到细胞3%的地区. (b) 一个像素的标准误差作为树冠高度的函数,在124块地块的高度范围内固化,并破碎于最高的地块(24.0米)之外,点给出相对的标准误差为5,10和20米. 不包括预测高度的误差.

blocks.en: Carbon stock across the natural domains
blocks.zh: 跨越自然领域的碳储存

blocks.en: We analysed the carbon map in ten natural domains of the Atlantic Forest defined by the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics 16 (“Carbon accounting by natural domain”). Table 8 and Figure 13 summarize the results.
blocks.zh: 我们分析了巴西地理和统计研究所划定的大西洋森林10个自然领域的碳图(“碳按自然领域核算”)。 表8和图13概述了结果。

blocks.en: The forest mapped inside the ten domains covers 28.3 Mha and holds 1,944 Tg C, for an overall mean of 68.8 Mg C ha -1 . A further 0.32 Mha of mapped forest, 1.1% of the total, lies inside the boundary of the Atlantic Forest region but outside the domain layer and is left out of the accounting.
blocks.zh: 绘制在10个域内的森林面积为28.3兆赫,拥有1 944兆赫C,总平均值为68.8兆赫C ha-1。 另有0.32兆赫的分布在大西洋森林区域边界内,占总面积的1.1%,但位于域层之外,不在核算范围之内。

blocks.en: The stock is concentrated. Three domains, the Dense Forest of the Eastern Southeast, the Subtropical Mixed Forest, and the Dense Forest of the East and Eastern Northeast, hold 1,253 Tg C, which is 64.5% of the total stock, on 55.7% of the total forest area. The Dense Forest of the Eastern Southeast is the densest and by far the best conserved of the ten, with 55.6% of its area still under forest and a mean of 98.8 Mg C ha -1 , so 5.04 Mha carry 498 Tg C. The Subtropical Mixed Forest of the Araucaria region carries the largest forest area of the ten domains, 6.82 Mha, at a mean of 67.0 Mg C ha -1 , and reaches 457 Tg C with a third more area and a third less density. At the other end, the Semideciduous Forest of the Southern West retains only 10.0% of its area under forest at a mean of 39.6 Mg C ha -1 , so it contributes 4.5% of the stock from 7.9% of the forest area. The four coastal domains together hold 0.80 Mha and 46 Tg C, 2.4% of the total stock, which reflects how narrow they are rather than how poor, since the Eastern Southeast Coast reaches a mean of 71.1 Mg C ha -1 , above six of the continental domains.
blocks.zh: 库存集中. 东东南的丹瑟林,亚热带混交林,东北和东北的丹瑟林三个地段,拥有1,253Tg C,占总种群的64.5%,占森林总面积的55.7%. 东部东南部的Dense森林是十大森林中密度最高和迄今保存最好的森林,55.6%的面积仍在森林之下,平均值为98.8 Mg C ha-1,因此5.04 Mha携带498 Tg C. 阿拉乌卡里亚地区的亚热带混合森林承载着十大领域最大的森林面积6.82 Mha,平均值为67.0 Mg C ha-1,达到457 Tg C,面积增加三分之一,密度减少三分之一. 另一方面,西南部半危森林仅保留森林面积的10.0%,平均为39.6 Mg C ha - 1,因此占森林面积的4.5%。 4个沿海地区共拥有0.80兆赫和46兆赫C,占总种群的2.4%,这反映了它们的狭小程度,而不是贫穷程度,因为东东南海岸面积在6个大陆地区以上达到71.1兆赫C ha-1的平均值。

blocks.en: The shape of the distributions separates the domains as clearly as their means (Fig. 13 b). In the two dense forest domains the distribution is broad and close to symmetric, with an interquartile range of 66.2 to 129.7 Mg C ha -1 in the Eastern Southeast and of 35.6 to 111.6 in the East and Eastern Northeast, and with 5% of the area above 177 and 164 Mg C ha -1 respectively. In the drier and more fragmented domains, the distribution collapses towards the origin and acquires a long right tail, so that the Eastern Northeast Coast has a median of 20.8 Mg C ha -1 and the Semideciduous Forest of the Southern West a median of 36.7, while their 95th percentiles still reach 71 and 81. The gradient of the medians, from 20.8 to 98.5 Mg C ha -1 , covers almost a factor of five across a single biogeographic region, and it follows the ordering of forest cover more closely than the ordering of domain area, which is what the fragmentation history of the Atlantic Forest would predict.

blocks.en: Usage Notes
blocks.zh: 使用说明

blocks.en: Choosing the resolution
blocks.zh: 选择决议

blocks.en: The canopy height layer is delivered at the native 10 m resolution of the Sentinel-2 grid because that is the scale at which the boundary-preserving branch was designed to work and at which the edges of fragments are resolved. Users whose quantity of interest is a stock over an area rather than the height of a single pixel should aggregate before using the values. About 16% of the pixel-level error at 10 m is spatially uncorrelated and cancels inside a 30 m cell, which lowers the root mean square error from 3.05 to 2.58 m without changing the bias (“Accuracy across sensor configurations”). The carbon layer is distributed at 30 m to match the size of the calibration field plots. Further aggregation to 90 m or 1 km reduces the random component further while leaving the systematic component.
blocks.zh: 树冠高度层是在哨兵-2网格的原生10米分辨率下交付的,因为这就是保护边界分支设计工作的规模,也是碎片边缘被解决的规模。 其利益量为某一区域库存而非单一像素高度的用户在使用这些值之前,应加以汇总。 10米时约16%的像素级错误在空间上不相关,在一个30米的单元格内取消,这将根平均方差从3.05米降低到2.58米而不改变偏差(“传感器配置的精确度”). 碳层分布在30米处,以配合校准场地块的大小. 进一步聚合到90米或1公里就可以进一步减少随机组件,同时离开系统组件.

blocks.en: Reading the height-dependent bias
blocks.zh: 读取高度依赖的偏差

blocks.en: The pooled bias of the model is close to zero, but it is the residue of two opposite errors. Short canopies below 10 m are overestimated by about 1.3 m and tall canopies above 30 m are underestimated by 6.5 m in the 30 to 40 m class and 16 m above 40 m (Fig. 7 ). The bias also grows with height at the two external sites, although at Serra do Conduru it is positive in every class (Table 7 ). Users should therefore expect the height layer to compress the upper tail of the canopy height distribution, and the carbon layer to inherit that compression, amplified by the exponent of Equation 12 , which is above unity. For analyses in which the tallest stands matter disproportionately, such as the stock of old-growth remnants on the coastal escarpment, the values in the upper classes should be treated as lower bounds. The bias by height class (Fig. 7 and Table 7 ) documents this compression. It is stratified by the reference height measured by LiDAR, which users of the map do not have. Because the model compresses the upper tail, pixels whose true height is above 30 m are mapped mostly into lower classes, so the class biases cannot be applied directly to classes of predicted height, where they would be misallocated and would create steps at the class limits. A correction requires a calibration of reference height against predicted height, which can be derived wherever airborne LiDAR is available.
blocks.zh: 模型的集合偏差接近0,但它是两个相反错误的残留. 10米以下的短树冠被高估约1.3米,30米以上高树冠被30至40米级的6.5米和40米以上16米(图7)低估。 虽然在Serra do Conduru, 每一类都有正面的倾向(表7), 因此,用户应该期望高度层会压缩树冠高度分布的上尾,碳层会继承这种压缩,由方程式12的加速器放大,这种压缩高于统一. 对于最高者不成比例的分析,如沿海树丛中老化的残留物,应将上层的数值视为下限值。 按高度分类的偏差(图7和表7)记录了这种压缩. 它由LiDAR测量的参考高度进行分层,地图用户没有这种高度. 由于模型压缩了上尾部,其真实高度在30m以上的像素大多被映射为下级,因此类偏差不能直接应用于预测高度的类别,在那里它们会被错位,并在类限上产生阶梯. 校正需要参照预测高度校准参考高度,只要有空载的LiDAR,即可得出参考高度。

blocks.en: Extrapolation outside the calibration window
blocks.zh: 校准窗口外推法

blocks.en: The network was trained almost entirely in São Paulo, and its fine-tuning added only 147 patches from outside the state, 132 from the Veracel station in southern Bahia and 15 from Jaraguá do Sul. The external validation shows how it behaves when it leaves the calibration window along two different axes, stature in Bahia and relief and latitude in Santa Catarina, and the results are heterogeneous, although only the Bahia site is independent of the training data. At the tall lowland rainforest of Serra do Conduru the bias is +2.5 m and grows with height, whereas at the escarpment forest of Jaraguá do Sul the model overestimates the short canopies of the lower classes. Users working in the northern half of the Atlantic Forest, where the only LiDAR available to us lies in southern Bahia, should regard the Bahia figures as the most relevant indication of performance and should read the error there as a conservative bound.
blocks.zh: 该网络几乎完全在圣保罗接受培训,其微调仅增加了来自州外的147个补丁,来自巴伊亚南部的Veracel站的132个补丁,以及来自南雅拉瓜的15个补丁. 外部验证显示,它沿着巴伊亚和圣卡塔琳娜的地势和纬度两个不同轴线离开校准窗口时,其行为方式各不相同,尽管只有巴伊亚站点独立于培训数据。 在Serra do Conduru高地的低地雨林中,偏差为+2.5米,并随高度而增长,而在Jaraguá do Sul的escarpment森林中,模型高估了下层阶层的短树冠。 在大西洋森林北半部工作的用户应该将巴伊亚数字视为最相关的业绩指标,应该将那里的错误理解为保守的束缚。

blocks.en: What the carbon layer does and does not represent
blocks.zh: 碳层是和不是代表的

blocks.en: Equation 12 converts a canopy height into the carbon density of an average stand of that height across the four categories of plot used to fit it. It does not know whether a given pixel is an old remnant, a degraded one, a natural regrowth or a restoration plantation. The calibration shows that for the same height a conserved remnant stores 1.25 kg m -2 more carbon than the curve predicts and a restoration plantation 0.36 kg m -2 less (Fig. 11 ). Users who have ancillary information on forest condition, for instance from forest age products 39 or from inventories, can improve the estimate by shifting the curve by these amounts. Without such information, the carbon layer should be read as an estimate of the stock that a stand of the mapped height typically holds, and the structural residual should be included in any uncertainty budget alongside the height error and the allometric error of the plots. The standard error of “Uncertainty of the carbon density map” already carries the structural residual and the random part of the allometric error through its residual term, so only the error of the predicted height remains to be added to it, with the first-order term of Equation 15 .
blocks.zh: 方程式12将树冠高度转换成该高度的平均站点的碳密度,跨越用于适合它的四类地块. 它不知道一个像素是旧的残余物,退化的残余物,自然的再生长还是恢复的种植园. 校准表明,在同一高度上,保存下来的残余储量比曲线预测的碳含量多1.25千克-2,而恢复的种植园则少0.36千克-2(图11)。 拥有森林状况辅助信息的用户,例如来自39岁森林年龄产品或库存的用户,可以通过这些金额改变曲线来改进估计值。 如果没有这种资料,碳层应理解为对所绘制的高度平面通常保持的存量的估计,结构残余应连同地块的高度误差和偏差列入任何不确定的预算。 “碳密度图的不确定性”的标准误差已经将结构残值和随机部分的过量误差通过其残值,因此,只有预测高度的误差尚待添加,其一级值为方程式15。

blocks.en: Temporal reference and the forest mask
blocks.zh: 临时参考和森林面具

blocks.en: Both layers describe the year 2024, the year of the annual composites. The LiDAR used for training was acquired in 2023 and 2024, so the training target and the predictors are contemporaneous to within one growing season. The carbon layer is masked to the MapBiomas 2024 forest classes, whose pixels are those with valid values in record 1. Because the mask is itself a classification with its own commission and omission errors, the carbon stock of a region depends on the mask as much as on the height model, and the two sources of uncertainty should be reported separately. Records 5 and 6, distributed without the mask, make it possible to recompute height and carbon stock under any alternative definition of forest.
blocks.zh: 两层都描述了2024年,即年度复合材料的年份. 用于训练的LiDAR是在2023年和2024年收购的,因此训练目标和预测器是同时期到一个生长季节的. 碳层被遮掩到MapBiomas 2024森林类,其像素是记录1中的有效值. 由于面具本身是一种分类,有其自身的发生和遗漏错误,因此一个区域的碳储量与高度模型一样依赖于面具,两个不确定源应当单独报告. 记录5和6在没有面具的情况下分发,使得有可能根据森林的任何替代定义重新计算高度和碳储存。

blocks.en: Intended uses
blocks.zh: 预定用途

blocks.en: The dataset was built for three kinds of applications. The first is carbon accounting at regional scale and for the Atlantic Forest as a whole, where the aggregation to 30 m and above gives a product whose random error is small and whose systematic error is documented by height class. The second is the study of forest dynamics at the scale of the fragment, where the 10 m resolution resolves edges, corridors and small remnants that coarser products merge with the matrix, and where the combination with annual land cover and forest age layers allows carbon to be tracked along chronosequences of regrowth. The third is the prioritization of restoration, for which the map provides the baseline stock and, when combined with the age of regenerating fragments, the realized rate of accumulation across the environmental gradients of the region. In all three cases, the class-wise bias and the standard errors of records 3 and 4 should be propagated into any derived quantity, and the training footprints, in São Paulo and at the sites of the fine-tuning patches, should be excluded when the product is evaluated against new reference data.
blocks.zh: 该数据集是为三种应用而构建的. 第一种是区域规模的碳核算和整个大西洋森林的碳核算,其中30米及以上的碳核算总和给出的产物随机误差小,且其系统误差按高度等级记录. 二是研究碎块规模的森林动态,10米分辨率解决了边缘,走廊和小残余物,使堆积产物与基质融合在一起,与年度土地覆盖物和森林年龄层的结合使得碳能够沿着重生的花序跟踪. 第三是优先恢复,地图提供了基线存量,如果结合再生碎片的年代,则该区域环境梯度之间实际的积累率。 在所有这三种情况下,记录3和4的分级偏差和标准错误应传播到任何数量,在根据新的参考数据评价产品时,圣保罗和微调补丁地点的培训足迹应排除在外。

blocks.en: Taken together, the two layers provide the first height and carbon reference for the Atlantic Forest that was calibrated inside the region, validated outside its calibration window and documented pixel by pixel against airborne LiDAR. The comparison with the global 1 m product over the same pixels shows that a model trained on regional LiDAR with multi-sensor fusion halves the error of a model trained to work everywhere, and the carbon accounting by natural domain shows that the map reproduces the structural gradient of the region. The remaining limitations, the compression of tall canopies, the structural residual of the height-to-carbon relationship, and the heterogeneity of performance outside São Paulo, are quantified rather than removed, and the records needed to correct for them are part of the dataset.
blocks.zh: 综合起来,这两层为大西洋森林提供了第一个高度和碳参考,在区域内进行了校准,在校准窗口外进行了验证,并以像素对空降的LiDAR进行了记录像素. 与全球1米产品对同一像素的比较表明,一个经过多传感器聚变的区域LiDAR培训的模型将一个经过培训到各地工作的模型的误差减半,按自然域进行的碳核算表明,地图复制了该区域的结构梯度. 其余的局限性,高树冠的压缩,高度对碳关系的结构残存,以及圣保罗以外的性能的异质性,都是量化的而不是去除的,对其纠正所需的记录是数据集的一部分.

blocks.en: Code availability
blocks.zh: 代码可用性

blocks.en: The code that trains the multi-sensor network and applies it to new patches is available at https://github.com/mpferreiraUSP/AtlanticForest_CHM . The repository contains three Python scripts and their documentation. model.py defines the network, with one branch per sensor fed at its native resolution, the gated fusion of the branch features on the Sentinel-2 grid and the regression head, together with the normalization of the inputs and the loading of checkpoints. train.py pairs the patches of each sensor by file name, computes the normalization statistics, trains the network with the mean absolute error and early stopping on the validation error, and writes checkpoints that carry the architecture and the normalization constants. A branch is created only when the folder of its sensor is given, so the same script trains every sensor configuration of “Experimental design”. predict.py rebuilds the network from a checkpoint, normalizes the inputs as in training, and writes one canopy height raster per Sentinel-2 patch, georeferenced when the inputs are GeoTIFF files. The file requirements.txt lists the dependencies, namely PyTorch 2.0 or later, segmentation-models-pytorch 0.3 or later, NumPy, rasterio, Matplotlib and tqdm, and the README describes the expected layout of the patches and the training options.
blocks.zh: 培训多传感器网络并将其应用于新补丁的代码见https://github.com/mpferreiraUSP/AtlanticForest_CHM 。 。 。 该寄存器包含三个Python脚本及其文档. model.py定义了网络,每个传感器有一个分支按其原生分辨率提供,在Sentinel-2网格和回归头上对分支特征进行加门融合,同时实现输入正常化和加载检查站。 火车。 py按文件名将每个传感器的补丁对齐,计算正常化统计,以平均绝对误差来训练网络并及早停止验证错误,并写出带有架构和正常化常数的检查点. 一个分支只有在其传感器的文件夹被给出时才会创建,所以同样的脚本会训练"实验设计"的每一个传感器配置. 预测.py从检查点重建网络,使输入与训练一样正常化,并写出每哨兵-2补丁一个树冠高度光栅,当输入是GeoTIFF文件时,地理参考。 文件要求.txt列出了依赖性,即PyTorch 2.0或以后,分区模型-pytorch 0.3或以后,NumPy,rasterio,Matplotlib和tqdm,README描述了补丁的预期布局和培训选项.

blocks.en: All networks were trained with the same data (São Paulo training patches and the same training and validation split), input normalization, loss function (MAE), optimizer, learning-rate schedule and early stopping (patience of 10 epochs on the validation MAE), and only the architecture differs. U-Net and MA-Net use a ResNet-50 encoder initialized with ImageNet weights, whereas BPAT-UNet has no pretrained encoder and is trained from random initialization. Metrics computed on n = 55,130,381 n=55{,}130{,}381 forest pixels per model, inside the MapBiomas forest mask and with LiDAR height > 0 >0 m. Bias = mean(LiDAR − - predicted), and Bias % is relative to the mean reference height. R 2 R^{2} from the ordinary least-squares fit of predicted vs. reference height. CCC is Lin’s concordance correlation coefficient and Params the number of trainable parameters. Bold marks the best value per column at the precision shown.
blocks.zh: 所有网络都接受了相同的数据培训(圣保罗培训补丁和相同的培训和验证拆分),输入正常化,损失函数(MAE),优化器,学习率时间表和早期停止(验证MAE上10个纪元的空间),只有架构不同. U-Net和MA-Net使用一个使用ImageNet权重初始化的ResNet-50编码器,而BPAT-UNet则没有经过预训的编码器,通过随机初始化来训练. 按n=55,130,381n=55{,}130{,}每个模型计算出381个森林像素,在MapBiomas森林面具内,并带有LiDAR高度 > 0>0 m. Bias = mean(LiDAR - - 预测),Bias%与平均参考高度相对. R 2 R^{2}从普通的最小方位 适合预测对参考高度。 CCC是Lin的和谐相关系数, 粗体标出每栏最高值的精确度。
